          <h1 title="Microsoft 365 connector tools" itemprop="name">
            Microsoft 365 connector tools
            
          </h1>

                  <div><button type="button" id="follow-button-0.5644878421398857" data-auth-action="signin" data-follower-count="0" data-selected="false" aria-describedby="subscriptons-description-0.5296542614666857" aria-label="Follow Article" aria-pressed="false">Follow</button><span class="IJDXXdfgVXcY6MRd9u66HghwrbdhBtJv" id="subscriptons-description-0.5296542614666857">Not yet followed by anyone</span></div>

        <section class="content article-content mb-6" itemprop="articleBody">
          <p>Optimizely Opal's <a href="#h_01KJGG7HV7X0QXPMSATEX2BPCK">Microsoft 365 connector tools</a> let you manage your Microsoft 365 calendar and file ecosystem directly within the Opal platform. These tools streamline meeting scheduling, calendar management, and file browsing across OneDrive and SharePoint, including capabilities for browsing document libraries, retrieving site pages, and organizing drives. The tools integrate with Microsoft 365, so you do not need to switch between Opal and the Microsoft 365 admin panel or individual apps like Outlook, Teams, or SharePoint.</p><h2 id="h_01KM6K2DNY86GMFD2KR2DEXHY7">Key capabilities<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KM6K2DNY86GMFD2KR2DEXHY7"></a></h2><h3 id="h_01KM6K2DNYAJWS71Q162NENC3Y">User and directory management<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KM6K2DNYAJWS71Q162NENC3Y"></a></h3><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e5f646136a7e01fa357f4ed086fc61b7b">
<strong>User profiles</strong> – Access and retrieve user information from Azure Active Directory.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edd876491b0ca22869386e6720807aa99">
<strong>Directory operations</strong> – Browse organizational structure and user relationships.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e03b21c71f6692313f918205eb97bd218">
<strong>Tenant information</strong> – Get details about the Microsoft 365 organization.</li>
</ul><h3 id="h_01KM6K2DP0FF5HSD4CZ1B3AQ51">File and drive operations<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KM6K2DP0FF5HSD4CZ1B3AQ51"></a></h3><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e64ca6378d9111c8e651283efe98d0472">
<strong>OneDrive access</strong> – Go to and manage files in OneDrive for Business.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0dab11d6c64b5ddb1af133768b3e59a1">
<strong>SharePoint integration</strong> – Access SharePoint sites and document libraries.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e516bd12bbee76b1aec7f0ef2d389c773">
<strong>Drive management</strong> – List and access organizational drives.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e72912a86764d11b42cad0f541514dabc">
<strong>File operations</strong> – Read, write, and manipulate files across Microsoft cloud storage.</li>
</ul><h3 id="h_01KM6K2DP11A45XY5JA6JBEGEK">Communication and collaboration<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KM6K2DP11A45XY5JA6JBEGEK"></a></h3><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ebfd497f1305f4e1a7d73f602aab01174">
<strong>SharePoint sites</strong> – Access collaborative workspaces and content.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efe8deeaa5576d9083efc5de0618e28b7">
<strong>Outlook Calendar</strong> – Schedule and manage meetings and events across your organization.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee937cdd1f38f363493786fbc241d9cea">
<strong>Outlook email</strong> – Send, read, and organize email messages without leaving Opal.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e105540ce14296e1dc5d2c9d19b62ce01">
<strong>OneDrive</strong> – Store, share, and collaborate on files and Office documents.</li>
</ul><h3 id="h_01KM6K2DP1MCPD9C2423F70TK3">Security and compliance<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KM6K2DP1MCPD9C2423F70TK3"></a></h3><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ed311b87fdb6ecd7687399a4795d19648">
<strong>Azure AD authentication</strong> – Secure authentication through Microsoft identity platform.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb983bf4772dbb49a7cf464e753b339d5">
<strong>Token management</strong> – Automatic token refresh and session management.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee8d44fe637b0706c6a7ad61a64aef512">
<strong>Permission scoping</strong> – Granular control over API access permissions.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3f86cc287223a1f7ab50612b87882c4d">
<strong>Audit logging</strong> – Comprehensive logging of API operations and access.</li>
</ul><h2 id="h_01KM6M3XJQKWK4A3APZKPXQX6H">Get started<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KM6M3XJQKWK4A3APZKPXQX6H"></a></h2><p>First, an <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/36359944449805">Opal administrator</a> must <a href="#h_01KM6ME4RQ9ENRXP94SV87SCRW">connect Opal with Microsoft 365</a> using Optimizely Connect Platform (OCP). Microsoft 365 uses system-level Open Authorization (OAuth) by default. After installing the connector in OCP and adding the tools to Opal, <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/39478258680333">users</a> and <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/43183109095949">agent builders</a> can optionally <a href="#h_01KJZX8RV2QTTTJF3AE1EPH73P">log in to Microsoft SharePoint, OneDrive, and Outlook Calendar</a> to access their personal Microsoft information from within Opal. Administrators only need to install the Microsoft 365 connection in OCP once.</p><h2 id="h_01KM6ME4RQ9ENRXP94SV87SCRW">Connect Opal with Microsoft 365<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KM6ME4RQ9ENRXP94SV87SCRW"></a></h2><p>As an <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/36359944449805">Opal administrator</a>, complete the following sections to connect Opal with Microsoft 365. Administrators only need to install the Microsoft 365 connection in OCP once.</p><h3 id="h_01KJZY0YFREMXZQAMCF4GGN86S">Install Microsoft 365 Opal Tools in OCP<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KJZY0YFREMXZQAMCF4GGN86S"></a></h3><p>In the OCP <strong>App Directory</strong>, complete the following:</p><ol>
<li data-list-item-id="e6f5dd67481ff3fede126b2267a85db6b">
<p>Click <strong>Microsoft 365 Opal Tools</strong>.</p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1762/1202;" src="/hc/article_attachments/44780471925645" alt="Screenshot of the Opal Connectors page where the Microsoft 365 tile is highlighted." width="1762" height="1202" class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e64e58de8f4961f1bc4d48ff417f33c48">
<p>Click <strong>Install</strong> <strong>App</strong>.</p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1768/1256;" src="/hc/article_attachments/44780423897741" alt="Screenshot of the Microsoft 365 Opal Tools app page in OCP where the Install App option is visible." width="1768" height="1256" class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
</ol><h3 id="h_01KME7ZQVG055XQ26GJ42B8KTA">Select tool sets<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KME7ZQVG055XQ26GJ42B8KTA"></a></h3><p>Opal enables all of the Microsoft 365 tools by default. If you do not want all of the Microsoft 365 tools enabled in Opal, complete the following steps:</p><ol>
<li data-list-item-id="ec0bf0e84fcaeb55dec5d6d27d6eb4035">Go to the <strong>Settings</strong> tab.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e30809cb2bd76c0201dac130b6f8fcff8">Expand <strong>Tool Sets</strong>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eeb850ce86d58962bbdd4d8aaf57f03c2">Toggle any of the tool sets on or off.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2ab63899d5a188ae028a0cb041e5e27d">
<p>Click <strong>Save</strong>.</p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1344/1080;" src="/hc/article_attachments/46383219349517" alt="Screenshot of the Tool Sets settings panel in OCP where the Save option is highlighted." width="1344" height="1080" class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
</ol><h3 id="h_01KN5D3ND7V05D8ZJGF790PFGZ">Add to Opal<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KN5D3ND7V05D8ZJGF790PFGZ"></a></h3><ol>
<li data-list-item-id="e612a365372399d8fcfb22f6e947171a4">Go to the <strong>Settings</strong> tab.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e507fff3150eb4582aec5e5dcbc24015c">Expand <strong>Add to Opal</strong>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e22e9b483b03ce47c468ffe9bc475f14b">
<p>Click <strong>Add to Opal</strong> to register the Microsoft 365 connector tools to the corresponding Opal instance.</p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1606/668;" src="/hc/article_attachments/46383192763533" width="1606" height="668" alt="Screenshot of the Add to Opal section in OCP with Add to Opal highlighted." class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
</ol><h3 id="h_01KN5ENTRA_AUTHORIZE">Authorize the Opal Microsoft tools in Microsoft Entra<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KN5ENTRA_AUTHORIZE"></a></h3><p>After an Opal administrator connects to the app in OCP, a prompt displays indicating that an administrator needs to authorize the connection. A Microsoft administrator must log in to the Microsoft Entra Admin Center and complete one of the following:</p><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e751fcda94afb15ff24bf83508ff4a447">
<strong>Add the Opal MS Graph Tool app to trusted apps</strong> – Grants the app access for all users in the organization.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eecd8e98b65a7f5f1af03679e18cced0f">
<strong>Configure access for individual groups</strong> – Restricts the app to specific groups within your organization.</li>
</ul><figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 800/344;" src="/hc/article_attachments/45069199683853" alt="Screenshot of the Microsoft Entra admin center where the required API permissions for the Opal application are configured." width="800" height="344" class="img-enlargable"></figure><p>After you complete the previous steps, users and agent builders can follow the steps in the <a href="#h_01KJZX8RV2QTTTJF3AE1EPH73P">Authenticate with Microsoft</a> section to log in with their personal information if you <a href="#h_01KME7YSWCPGDXSS9HTMBZQFD5">enabled instance-level Opal OAuth</a>.</p><h3 id="h_01KME7YSWCPGDXSS9HTMBZQFD5">Enable self-managed instance-level OAuth (Optional)<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KME7YSWCPGDXSS9HTMBZQFD5"></a></h3><p>The Microsoft 365 tools use Optimizely-managed OAuth by default. This configuration is not required for most organizations and can be skipped. Complete this section only if your organization requires self-managed instance-level OAuth.</p><p>If your organization requires self-managed instance-level OAuth, complete the following steps:</p><ol>
<li data-list-item-id="ee960ae6da352807658517c54a0f3b62a">Go to the <strong>Settings</strong> tab.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e432546b663b7110995e8bce48919c495">Expand <strong>Microsoft 365 Settings</strong>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e05b3db355dc8598a21f561a101f77bd1">Toggle <strong>Instance level Opal OAuth</strong> on.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebeda3eea835820a95e02e63192faab98">Enter your <strong>Microsoft 365 auth provider ID</strong>, which is the name of the Microsoft 365 auth provider connection configured in Opal. </li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb09d069bc3361d10cf29474035783ff4">
<p>Click <strong>Save</strong>. </p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1384/592;" src="/hc/article_attachments/46383219351053" width="1384" height="592" class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
</ol><h2 id="h_01KJZX8RV2QTTTJF3AE1EPH73P">Authenticate with Microsoft<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KJZX8RV2QTTTJF3AE1EPH73P"></a></h2><p>After an administrator <a href="#h_01KM6ME4RQ9ENRXP94SV87SCRW">connects Opal with Microsoft 365</a>, log in from Opal to access your information. User-level authorization ensures you can only access data you have permission to access within Microsoft.</p><p>The Microsoft 365 connector tools have four corresponding connectors in Opal. Connect to all to unlock all enabled tools.</p><p>To authenticate, complete the following steps in Opal:</p><ol>
<li data-list-item-id="ec36bbf58935c18603d7fa8cc06fab6e8">Go to <strong>Tools > Connectors</strong>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e77039d8c0ebc5e21efd7eb7c2e6db3d6">
<p>Select Microsoft from the <strong>Provider</strong> drop-down list.</p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 2308/1180;" src="/hc/article_attachments/46383219351437" width="2308" height="1180" alt="Screenshot of the Connectors tab on the Tools page with the Provider drop-down expanded with the Microsoft option highlighted." class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee2f2ae229f9aa3f2b687b73ba0a328d7">Click<strong> Connect</strong> on each Microsoft connector.<ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ead927e4f22fcea6775d3e47c4cfdc752">
<p><strong>Microsoft OneDrive & SharePoint</strong></p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1710/650;" src="/hc/article_attachments/46383192763917" width="1710" height="650" alt="Screenshot of the Connectors with the Microsoft Onedrive & Sharepoint connect highlighted" class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea5d9c95007c5e87c1d789ce1cf84af4a">
<p><strong>Outlook Email</strong></p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1658/608;" src="/hc/article_attachments/46383192764173" width="1658" height="608" alt="Screenshot of the Connectors with the Outlook Email connect highlighted" class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e899fd46ca57399031b9bcadbf27326fa">
<p><strong>Microsoft Outlook Calendar</strong></p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1678/628;" src="/hc/article_attachments/46383219352461" width="1678" height="628" alt="Screenshot of the Connectors with the Microsoft Outlook Calendar connect highlighted" class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eb92f7b89cc81ecdf927fa91c85658c78">
<p><strong>Microsoft Teams</strong></p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1666/606;" src="/hc/article_attachments/46383219352589" width="1666" height="606" alt="Screenshot of the Connectors with the Microsoft Teams connect highlighted" class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e32e830aa61ca6a76dceaea10047bef1f">Log in to Microsoft for each connection.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee6aa9eda98edf642406697ab55881017">Grant the requested permissions.</li>
</ol><h2 id="h_01KJGG7HV7X0QXPMSATEX2BPCK">Microsoft 365 connector tools<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KJGG7HV7X0QXPMSATEX2BPCK"></a></h2><p>After an administrator <a href="#h_01KJZY0YFREMXZQAMCF4GGN86S">installs Microsoft 365 in OCP</a> and you <a href="#h_01KJZX8RV2QTTTJF3AE1EPH73P">authenticate with Microsoft</a>, call the following tools in Opal. Click a tool's name to expand it and learn when to use the tool, required and optional parameters, and example prompts on how to call the tool. If you do not provide a required parameter, Opal prompts you for it.</p><h3 id="h_01KM6M6XKK7B39RHJ24DHKWN41">Microsoft Outlook Calendar tools<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KM6M6XKK7B39RHJ24DHKWN41"></a></h3><details><summary><code>outlook_calendar_create_meeting</code> – Creates a new calendar event or meeting in Microsoft Outlook.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e3f77bede3f65d91c648b85a1f3c10f84">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eaf986a8c402ba0d55b4309db3144fc5a">Schedule a new meeting with one or more attendees directly from Opal.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e96a798a6401a7f12f4320f752bce98dc">Create an online Teams meeting with a generated join URL.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebe6990188fcd80705482eab5c1d49832">Set up a calendar event with a specific location, agenda, and reminder.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1326d592cab376406a7262600b27373f">Book a recurring or time-sensitive meeting without leaving your workflow.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecb5635a28f7332ef0d1b72c11d5b59c1">Create a meeting on behalf of another user's calendar.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e765bd8e09489c92a765c140fd537629d">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eae37025fb70f4d67c94d2f46aa33d0ce">
<code>subject</code> – The title or subject of the meeting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0471be0d17b73e4a4ad7971ed199075b">
<code>start</code> – The meeting start date and time, including timezone. Format: <code>{"dateTime": "2024-12-01T10:00:00", "timeZone": "UTC"}</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1c8f5cb193a0cfb46fa48546c1f20ea5">
<code>end</code> – The meeting end date and time, including timezone. Format: <code>{"dateTime": "2024-12-01T11:00:00", "timeZone": "UTC"}</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e51f7d339c4118c4d99b0b3f681eb3109">(Optional) <code>attendees</code> – A list of attendees with their names and email addresses. Format: <code>[{"emailAddress": {"name": "Jane Doe", "address": "jane@example.com"}, "type": "required"}]</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea65c03daf4368d5958ae33607e4ef0a9">(Optional) <code>body</code> – The meeting description or agenda. Format: <code>{"contentType": "HTML", "content": "Meeting description here."}</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8eab42d5bb58924e35abbac43bf472fd">(Optional) <code>location</code> – The physical or virtual location of the meeting. Format: <code>{"displayName": "Conference Room A"}</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0c9414dc0dc433e6ac31e08909ea8802">(Optional) <code>isOnlineMeeting</code> – Set to <code>true</code> to generate a Teams or Skype join link.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e42d7e2de9cc736eef116f54b510f2e45">(Optional) <code>onlineMeetingProvider</code> – The online meeting provider: <code>teamsForBusiness</code> or <code>skypeForBusiness</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8d7e0742c0b339948add13b74c70446a">(Optional) <code>importance</code> – Priority of the meeting: <code>low</code>, <code>normal</code>, or <code>high</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2f91c1bdc76769377a6743bc372636f4">(Optional) <code>reminderMinutesBeforeStart</code> – Number of minutes before the meeting to send a reminder (for example, <code>15</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eec5e8f51a1bcd60838ef8f87ed5bc855">(Optional) <code>categories</code> – Comma-separated tags or categories to organize the meeting (for example, <code>"Q4, Sales"</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4347954b920873692c660e2e2cd2bd49">(Optional) <code>isAllDay</code> – Set to <code>true</code> to create an all-day event.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e84e18373d48cda50e81ec163e5b5dad7">(Optional) <code>isReminderOn</code> – Set to <code>true</code> to enable reminders for this meeting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e004ee7d89a35c08d7f766e1f4fd2ee99">(Optional) <code>showAs</code> – How the time appears in the calendar: <code>free</code>, <code>tentative</code>, <code>busy</code>, <code>oof</code>, or <code>workingElsewhere</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e97b3151bfdfd5a1726c42fbd08c76ed2">(Optional) <code>calendarId</code> – The ID of a specific calendar to create the meeting in.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5df5b3ef0f652f64759e5b8025621997">(Optional) <code>userId</code> – The ID of another user whose calendar should be used. Defaults to the authenticated user.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef42374d4fea59a8bf96e3ffefdc69870">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e50506a196c490abaf5e42fe62085829b"><em>Schedule a 1-hour Teams meeting called "Q4 Planning Sync" tomorrow at 10am with jane.doe@example.com and mark.smith@example.com.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eabc2ac263b2690594ca857f7ba0649e8"><em>Create a meeting called "Campaign Review" on December 5th from 2pm to 3pm in Conference Room B, and set the importance to high.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e54c77d972d321361760dc596d1019c67"><em>Book an online meeting for next Monday at 9am titled "Onboarding Kickoff" and include the agenda: cover product setup, access provisioning, and Q&A.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e16d4001b95bc79a8ad25109030f17d45"><em>Set up a 30-minute meeting called "Design Handoff" on Friday at 11am with a 15-minute reminder and invite the design team at design@example.com.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e0f25b97fa0c5cda56c794d6063878add"><em>Create an all-day calendar event called "Company Offsite" on March 10th and mark it as out of office.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_calendar_delete_meeting</code> – Deletes an existing calendar event or meeting from Outlook.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e492088b38b7365c80e389527df67c3aa">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eae7ea7374d3ee65ac6bbc5e80c414072">Cancel and remove a meeting from a user's calendar.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9c9922f54d2ddb64083678e1463f4048">Clean up outdated or duplicate calendar events.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8fd1d19f68bef7643df5fd8d676f4660">Delete a meeting that was created in error.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7a53b038e67c7e41402166d9a1f9a23f">Remove a meeting from a specific calendar or on behalf of another user.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ee7c59d45ab1cbef430627b81841a4631">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e4c1d50a409584f56119a5a6b0482f6c9">
<code>meetingId</code> – The unique identifier of the meeting to delete.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eafb1e98303632096f3a413a67a0f6689">(Optional) <code>calendarId</code> – The ID of the specific calendar containing the meeting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecbd196a6a3ca6da0afdfa2a2bcd77dec">(Optional) <code>userId</code> – The ID of the user whose calendar to delete from. Defaults to the authenticated user.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e494e2deb319ade6ce2216453e27693fa">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e852cfdaa631be567563bfdcff0c57f74"><em>Delete the meeting with ID AAMkAGI2TGuLAAA= from my calendar.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e7ac6c7119d17108d3d100bcdc798b30a"><em>Cancel the meeting AAMkAGI2TGuLAAA= on behalf of user john.doe@example.com.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e3f29623d430fe89c6b36dfa5410d704b"><em>Remove the meeting AAMkAGI2TGuLAAA= from calendar AAMkAGI2TGuLBBB=.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_calendar_get_meeting</code> – Retrieves detailed information about a specific calendar event or meeting from Microsoft Graph.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef4b002698d5a8ce782c7afd1d38a837e">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e57d73e981a063680c2d6a2046851f33c">Look up the full details of a specific meeting, including attendees, time, and location.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9cd7b257fd848a15cb82e01ba3267998">Check the online meeting join URL for a Teams or Skype meeting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eadc3cdbf3059b54f18b16aa769c2fab5">Retrieve attendee response statuses for a scheduled meeting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb6854461b15ff727a5cb077778a2714b">Access meeting recurrence settings or attached files.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e410e644ec5d45e84820686304c7d26e4">Verify meeting details before making updates or sending communications.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e04c4fee8da44f60ca98aa4292f50e22f">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ecd26258913a5b838d15a54f0ee147860">
<code>meetingId</code> – The unique identifier of the meeting to retrieve.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e19493976ef5a7cccdfe3e95d3488303a">(Optional) <code>select</code> – Comma-separated list of specific fields to return (for example, <code>subject,start,end,organizer,attendees,location</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e202051d52d48f8a78fdd48b8f380628f">(Optional) <code>expand</code> – Comma-separated list of related entities to expand in the response (for example, <code>calendar,attachments</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8b558c48030378802c0987422d85fb5b">(Optional) <code>calendarId</code> – The ID of the specific calendar containing the meeting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef9f5591ebb06438bbcfe85106622c413">(Optional) <code>userId</code> – The ID of the user whose calendar to query. Defaults to the authenticated user.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e5faaaa0d1cce16ef9983ba608079fcd3">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e98fc66997187a50a36917299588bd938"><em>Get the details of meeting AAMkAGI2TGuLAAA= from my calendar.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e6400dc7e42f23f47090f9838a0c4ae5a"><em>Show me the attendees and their response statuses for meeting AAMkAGI2TGuLAAA=.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ea3b727409198618111e9f179432ae36f"><em>Retrieve the Teams join URL for meeting AAMkAGI2TGuLAAA=.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb2316797d3f82365d87e64d1588b7abb"><em>Get the subject, start time, end time, and organizer for meeting AAMkAGI2TGuLAAA= on john.doe@example.com's calendar.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e7cb52b20bb9ea4ae40d7838e0bace7e2"><em>Show me the full details of meeting AAMkAGI2TGuLAAA=, including any attachments.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_calender_get_schedule</code> – Retrieves the free and busy availability schedule for one or more users from Microsoft Outlook. Retrieves the availability information for a list of users, distribution lists, or resources for a specified time period. It returns the busy and free time blocks and scheduled items.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e0b4b767bd025626264650bf053afd387">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e157b0c4f0189ab17d9287a9842d1cb2d">Check availability of one or more people before scheduling a meeting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e588782fc578dfecedc8a4c4e99a1dce5">Find joint availability across multiple attendees.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efc9e97d2e3defd01d423f02a39dff2ec">View the free and busy status for a specific time frame.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e82ad610362e5f4b1f506842d4a798ea1">Determine when people are available for meetings.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0418a430863b6724cd74b5cdd1e17572">Plan meetings based on multiple attendees' calendars.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e3df4e6d8c796485cec73de6b41661cf2">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e4379b0f16f12f72ecc9cf1974023bb8c">
<code>endTime</code> – End of the time range to check availability, as a JSON string with dateTime and timeZone. Example: <code>{'dateTime': '2025-04-10T18:00:00', 'timeZone': 'America/New_York'}</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e40bbf6e2543c935c731264909726f23f">
<code>schedules</code> – Email addresses of users to check availability for, as a JSON string array. Single user example: <code>['jane.smith@company.com']</code>. Multiple users example: <code>['alex@company.com', 'bob@company.com']</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7bca705a84164f935a9b00ce4d0f1407">
<code>startTime</code> – Start of the time range to check availability, as a JSON string with dateTime and timeZone. Example: <code>{'dateTime': '2025-04-10T08:00:00', 'timeZone': 'America/New_York'}</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee1890b770ee997c226ac3a97a3620b96">
<code>availabilityViewInterval</code> – Duration of each time slot in minutes for the availability view (default: 30). Valid values: 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 60.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e649957f934198ad732d09d2acf00641a">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5747b5d7a6fc3bf09b2eab8e44fa2f12"><em>Check if John@company.com and Jane@company.com are free tomorrow afternoon.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e293befbd94933313a3ec589d254f8499"><em>When is the entire marketing team available next week?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb215c79333892ec09ed8f234f1f3c0e7"><em>What does my schedule look like for tomorrow morning?</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_calendar_list_meetings</code> – Retrieves a list of calendar events or meetings from a user's Microsoft Graph calendar.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e7f2511162e8b1019c9eaed01299747d2">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e2a2225aa96d9dba51c743511e84bf3ae">View all upcoming meetings within a specific date range.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7d5ce2eb1e8a526d15456e8bcdd0676f">Search for meetings by subject or keyword.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e00c44cfb6ea595fe5e07bef49011e4e5">Retrieve a paginated list of calendar events for review or reporting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5a03cb603e1510a0c883d8313b56759d">Check meetings on behalf of another user's calendar.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e989d968646d302dd195b6174b52c6125">Filter and sort meetings to find specific events.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e5c558da76b235f718e9fa965588d06d0">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e4b94e44573dd1b79ff556c01a1d5ea54">(Optional) <code>startDateTime</code> – Start of the time range to filter meetings (for example, <code>2024-12-01T00:00:00Z</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec2276829dfb1f3cbad6c670e93637f3c">(Optional) <code>endDateTime</code> – End of the time range to filter meetings (for example, <code>2024-12-31T23:59:59Z</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eeebe03f79a5a7e4bd6accfe5c52fd9e7">(Optional) <code>top</code> – Maximum number of meetings to return. Defaults to 50, max 999.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7ad8996362b8fcf15042eb121d6d7f76">(Optional) <code>skip</code> – Number of meetings to skip for pagination.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e94a77887be81b06167423cefcd78799c">(Optional) <code>filter</code> – Data filter expression for advanced filtering (for example, <code>contains(subject,'team')</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e16320d2614811d50f4cc74c614abe442">(Optional) <code>orderBy</code> – Field to sort results by (for example, <code>start/dateTime desc</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5a47c90d63055fe6155967de0f91599e">(Optional) <code>select</code> – Comma-separated list of specific fields to return (for example, <code>subject,start,end,organizer</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6b878215beafeb74cb850df522f73dab">(Optional) <code>calendarId</code> – The ID of a specific calendar to list meetings from.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebc494a1d8d56a2d22a55af093ff679ac">(Optional) <code>userId</code> – The ID of the user whose calendar to query. Defaults to the authenticated user.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e000cfa9246d7321a2e2ee695d360381a">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed5920263da0fe684ef3e1d74fd6a987c"><em>Show me all my meetings in December 2024.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ee5dbc287776c1378e7188d26240add63"><em>List my next 10 upcoming calendar events.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="efb7b388878a4fce3a38cfd286fdfa46b"><em>Find all meetings with "team" in the subject from this month.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e43e64f71b2d75c36e7dbbcedc629e0cb"><em>Show meetings on john.doe@example.com's calendar for next week, sorted by start time.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec23583238dc1e5cc58be2ab63fb5114e"><em>List my meetings from January 1st to January 31st, showing only the subject, start, and end time.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_calendar_update_meeting</code> – Updates an existing calendar event or meeting in Microsoft Outlook.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e9e2fb3602b266f21a5e98504d97ef1de">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e08c4c5edb1f310b89ff064005f9d1a74">Change the time, date, or duration of an existing meeting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebb0ddefeef69b6f0c7ad7376b8502291">Add or remove attendees from a scheduled meeting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9c33d9a0663c629d763e0c89479718ef">Update the meeting agenda, location, or subject.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea8b8ecf086e36668340a82f20a18777b">Change the importance level or reminder settings on a meeting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e176f236fc2acdbbe3b0576d5f1feb9f1">Convert an in-person meeting to an online Teams meeting.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e45606121a1c2f6955bfa18004cc2ddf5">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e342bd6d377df0592791993152b0c4ca8">
<code>meetingId</code> – The unique identifier of the meeting to update.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb93085469d78994cc5e31b5b2c6e247a">(Optional) <code>subject</code> – The new title or subject of the meeting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2c799cdcabad79fe08cc2fca652e7ee3">(Optional) <code>start</code> – The new meeting start date and time, including timezone. Format: <code>{"dateTime": "2024-12-01T10:00:00", "timeZone": "UTC"}</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8b4601759baccf0d31699b61345ca4f8">(Optional) <code>end</code> – The new meeting end date and time, including timezone. Format: <code>{"dateTime": "2024-12-01T11:00:00", "timeZone": "UTC"}</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee064e8c6758e155ff58c22c0ba5e04e0">(Optional) <code>attendees</code> – Updated list of attendees with their names and email addresses. Format: <code>[{"emailAddress": {"name": "Jane Doe", "address": "jane@example.com"}, "type": "required"}]</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8e5a08bd887d225658e6c9f407703a6d">(Optional) <code>body</code> – The new meeting description or agenda. Format: <code>{"contentType": "HTML", "content": "Updated agenda here."}</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3a855b9853426bdcc20b00619321d201">(Optional) <code>location</code> – The new meeting location. Format: <code>{"displayName": "Conference Room B"}</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2177aba8dff6cb207265c924e77836ce">(Optional) <code>isOnlineMeeting</code> – Set to <code>true</code> to add a Teams or Skype join link.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea6e87cbb141c1c9ab29514f5157fe36f">(Optional) <code>onlineMeetingProvider</code> – The online meeting provider: <code>teamsForBusiness</code> or <code>skypeForBusiness</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9951a09f90b04ebf4b316ce3c7fb74aa">(Optional) <code>importance</code> – Updated priority of the meeting: <code>low</code>, <code>normal</code>, or <code>high</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb5e3c66f1f3cefd32864e6f8c2d5413a">(Optional) <code>reminderMinutesBeforeStart</code> – Updated number of minutes before the meeting to send a reminder.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eda723854116cc515bdc56b54f84ea760">(Optional) <code>categories</code> – Updated comma-separated tags or categories for the meeting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee9dfa386c8da45ba6b7262c6cf21d786">(Optional) <code>isReminderOn</code> – Set to <code>true</code> to enable reminders for this meeting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e614a0a8911429588741ce79a78f8b139">(Optional) <code>showAs</code> – How the time appears in the calendar: <code>free</code>, <code>tentative</code>, <code>busy</code>, <code>oof</code>, or <code>workingElsewhere</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8e9d8ddf3fffccc61f4b5c0f57eb164c">(Optional) <code>calendarId</code> – The ID of the specific calendar containing the meeting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e51a644b30cc69cd2e943aacd9fa66e7c">(Optional) <code>userId</code> – The ID of the user whose calendar to update. Defaults to the authenticated user.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ee7f1d299b1b282e43fee3608f2c51396">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e1e8446d99533a758748b32298fce63e4"><em>Update the meeting AAMkAGI2TGuLAAA= to start at 3pm instead of 2pm.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e9418b7bbaf08c9f79b04bccbc34cb60b"><em>Add jane.doe@example.com as an attendee to meeting AAMkAGI2TGuLAAA=.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e09fe9b945d4382da1bd97aa88db0f6db"><em>Change the subject of meeting AAMkAGI2TGuLAAA= to "Q1 Strategy Review" and update the location to Conference Room C.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e48724bc46d3839f6be7cd9d368013a05"><em>Convert meeting AAMkAGI2TGuLAAA= to a Teams online meeting and set the importance to high.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e4b15fa2a6941806e7623da9a46389937"><em>Update the agenda for meeting AAMkAGI2TGuLAAA= to include a section on budget review and set a 30-minute reminder.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h3 id="h_01KM6M7DA4C8958N76RP7NM4ZW">Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint tools<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KM6M7DA4C8958N76RP7NM4ZW"></a></h3><details><summary><code>microsoft_onedrive_generate_office_file</code> – Generates a new Microsoft Office file and uploads it to OneDrive or SharePoint.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eebf396307a6c85c126c96fd489cd6dfd">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e0ca1fc72bbeb37e9c1a3eb2b09615f7a">Create new Word documents (<code>.docx</code>) with formatted text, markdown headers, and images.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecb09d0595647f129f9370d225fbf5639">Create new Excel spreadsheets (<code>.xlsx</code>) from tabular, tab-separated, or CSV-style content.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7bcb3bdb738b3de9f06a297b50979b2b">Save generated files to specific OneDrive drives, SharePoint sites, or specific folder locations.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7623739438a6e50be2ab9bdfbd638f8c">Generate documents using specific templates like blank, letter, report, or memo.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ee5705e9d608e65ec156f226109acf4fa">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e3481a1a8db0ac2357af0647ba70f45da">
<code>title</code> – The title and filename for the new file.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eecbd33fad4b1fa87db7f36831fd8366d">
<code>content</code> – The main content of the file. <ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e1f58e1d20fc0917d65197422cdca7fcd">For <code>docx</code> – Supports markdown headers and images. </li>
<li data-list-item-id="eef037475ba8f37a81076b9deb53315b1">For <code>xlsx</code> – Supports tab or comma-separated rows or markdown tables.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef06de48c247c675c4cdc40e9d063a40d">(Optional) <code>driveId</code> – OneDrive or SharePoint drive ID to save the file to. Leave empty to use the default drive.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0e9476cd789c6dc83180c1395db60f2c">(Optional) <code>fileType</code> – File type to generate: <code>docx</code> (Word, default) or <code>xlsx</code> (Excel).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec5aa41022a3d80e47072a52e16da6b50">(Optional) <code>folderId</code> – Folder ID within the drive or site to save the file to. Leave empty to save to the root folder.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0aebfa134b01367609315259f29f2f11">(Optional) <code>siteId</code> – SharePoint site ID to save the file to. Leave empty to use your personal OneDrive.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6900235c6a767b1088936ad24e207e40">(Optional) <code>template</code> – Template style (<code>.docx</code> only). Options include the following: <code>blank</code> (default), <code>letter</code>, <code>report</code>, or <code>memo</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eb648987d6b7b237b32101861c768a9cf">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e464b87c7250955079cea05602caa9c14"><em>Generate a new Word document titled "Q3 Marketing Report" using the report template and include a summary of our past campaigns in the content.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ef2584983995235ca3c5b16c77f1ad0bf"><em>Create an Excel file named "Monthly Budget" with a markdown table containing my expenses and save it to my OneDrive root folder.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e1a687843d5b6a54a25cbad3d1fa150fb"><em>Create a memo document titled "Team Updates" for the engineering team and save it in the designated SharePoint site.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>microsoft_onedrive_get_drive</code> – Retrieves detailed information about a specific OneDrive or SharePoint drive.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e5980627250c32d01f1c61434795b827e">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ee63626d86ede24aca4dc006a7435b323">Get metadata and details about a specific drive by its ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecfebe39ef599b300968087a8291f5dad">Check storage quota and usage information for a drive.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e21c1286c2911adf369b518c94724728c">Retrieve the default drive for the currently authenticated user.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e90cb5afa7e28aeab2368bc007eeebc46">Look up drive ownership and type information before browsing its contents.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e5a13425d8bea326fa21bb2667d961762">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e21f02ff647049d91795517610700ab3e">(Optional) <code>driveId</code> – The ID of the specific drive to retrieve. If not provided, returns the default drive for the user.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edb991db32cd352f63685fb7f2ad171b5">(Optional) <code>userId</code> – The ID of the user to get the default drive for. Use <code>me</code> for the currently authenticated user.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="efaf41b37fea342c3a11ecdb42c26d57b">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e613d2da04f89d351f5e3751a9ed8fa68"><em>Get details about my default OneDrive.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5807bd433e2050da3fb08e623ec830b6"><em>Show me the storage quota and usage for drive b!abc123def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="efc25b7f15895809241782bee182896a7"><em>Get information about the default drive for user john.doe@example.com.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e1dd5349148a6ebe43de91b7f095023c7"><em>What are the details of drive b!abc123def456, including its type and owner?</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>microsoft_onedrive_get_file_content</code> – Reads and extracts the text content of a file stored in OneDrive or SharePoint.</summary><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e732278d24e62763da556f140e20cb737">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e4410fa4b163063b456896082437f1640">Read, summarize, or analyze the contents of a document.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e85ac92b07031bc9b476238127c157a25">Extract text from supported file types, specifically Word documents (<code>.docx</code>) or plain text files (<code>.txt</code>).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ebe7f9d17ac74aed64fbf06e4a2c2a36b">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ea7054d56964a62f3fe080bf9ce536f24">
<code>sharingUrl</code> – A SharePoint or OneDrive sharing URL (the link you get from <strong>Copy link</strong> or <strong>Share</strong>). </li>
<li data-list-item-id="ede88ceb1b88387aa0dd9bf0819fa7f17">
<code>driveId</code> – The ID of the drive where the file lives. Required when not using <code>sharingUrl</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e733e429dfd67fea94e9a25e816473937">
<code>itemId</code> – The Item ID of the file. Required when not using <code>sharingUrl</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eb080cd465b4f9f036e55b80eee7c14c0">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb2122cb1fd2521342c7d174f750e6e1f"><em>Can you summarize the document at this link: https://contoso.sharepoint.com/:w:/r/xyz123?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e434d0ffb100d571c6f38ffd7eeed4162"><em>Read the contents of the text file shared here: https://1drv.ms/t/s!abc123.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e8edf6fc568fbe42a31bc4375b22138f2"><em>Analyze the Q3 report document in drive b!abc123def456 with item ID 01XYZabcde.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eafad614c58bea405751e8c650c486d23"><em>Extract the action items from the meeting notes document at this SharePoint link.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e3b268cc1fc4309b3e453f06a94dff799"><em>What does the "Project Brief.docx" file say? Its drive ID is b!1ab2c and item ID is 01FG45.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></details><details><summary><code>microsoft_onedrive_list_all_drives</code> – Lists all OneDrive drives accessible to the authenticated user, including personal, shared, and SharePoint site drives.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed8c69fc7f94e7e572e7bd6c571558f45">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ec5789d6bb2c9529db38c2c263b1ffa07">Get a comprehensive list of all OneDrive drives the current user has access to.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e05ecd40f4e322cc50c25d1b5b0c2b8b4">Discover shared drives or SharePoint site drives alongside a personal OneDrive.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea3d7f9b00c42411273cc44783fbbd278">Retrieve drive IDs, storage quota, and ownership information for available drives.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6564d0086fc01ddc7eb14caac06ee0e3">Identify which drives to target before browsing or searching for files.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e159f15a85613c7dca9cfb20123b8b1da">Audit available storage locations across personal and organizational drives.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e4a310a1af110f45743dba2d8e8827218">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ed00a508c26ea5bf16961487d5314688d">(Optional) <code>includePersonal</code> – Set to <code>true</code> to include the user's personal OneDrive. Defaults to <code>true</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e840ed13a6aba1c5843405b2fce764bc0">(Optional) <code>includeShared</code> – Set to <code>true</code> to include drives shared with the user. Defaults to <code>true</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb7affd6cab836dbbd809121af5e05d28">(Optional) <code>includeSites</code> – Set to <code>true</code> to include drives from SharePoint sites. Defaults to <code>true</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ede0069fc15b16da4bcb6e86720976159">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e79fe873effc2ac3bbb5a3df6eb6b8b61"><em>Show me all OneDrive drives I have access to.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e994a22ac60ba25f755f42dd76126afbf"><em>List only my personal OneDrive, not shared or site drives.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec4cd20649ba2cabf5cef6b49d6206584"><em>What SharePoint site drives are available to me?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e99e929d65cb62c91f7f3b06db0525381"><em>Show me all shared drives accessible to me, excluding personal and site drives.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ef867a87d4dca6d3a2f4eca9112257290"><em>List all my available drives so I can find where a file is stored.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>microsoft_onedrive_list_drive_contents</code> – Lists files and folders in an OneDrive or SharePoint drive location.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e4502fb1eab5d0ed3fc402a5520f36f13">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ee8cbafe1f30bd7724550e18960a5564b">Browse the contents of an OneDrive or SharePoint document library.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea8379e286aa96fea11a1212b1250a23c">Go through folder structures to find specific files.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e64084d66abd3339997997b01cfaf0dd1">Filter drive contents by file type (for example, only show PDFs or PowerPoint files).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0d5cc8556b164dbcc5771912f7f473ca">Retrieve file metadata such as size, last modified date, and download URLs.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e131ed5fc96e7910d58ffc523f68e1d1c">Paginate through large folders with many files or subfolders.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e2f0f7c8f055879a8a8a4dfa74efeb969">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e08ed4dec4eb75b630c049be725f64ef2">
<code>driveId</code> – The unique identifier of the OneDrive or SharePoint drive to browse.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2319e000eeb3b4b5e20bec5551c61a87">(Optional) <code>folderPath</code> – Path to a specific folder within the drive (for example, <code>Documents/Projects</code>). Defaults to the root.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e46179fb01e58a754d6cd59a8fa777f2d">(Optional) <code>folderId</code> – The ID of a specific folder to list contents of. Can be used as an alternative to <code>folderPath</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecf35c3c20cd2ea566cdf1f74db8fd94a">(Optional) <code>fileType</code> – Filter results by file extension (for example, <code>pptx</code>, <code>docx</code>, or <code>pdf</code>). Returns only files matching this type.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0e0c99b193b9fb338612cca2f083f84e">(Optional) <code>top</code> – Maximum number of items to return per page. Defaults to 100.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e763b739286727f3c89d458954ea28b8d">(Optional) <code>nextLink</code> – Pagination URL returned from a previous response. Use this to retrieve the next page of results. Do not modify the URL.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e6a0808894ac165dfd1f081d24a973423">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e64313d86c117f40665510d064ab0692d"><em>List all files in my OneDrive drive b!abc123def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e91c413c4a2ed35085ea6328b70ec8b4b"><em>Show me the contents of the Documents/Projects folder in drive b!abc123def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e61251fb17bd73571af4de6bebdd3244a"><em>List only the PowerPoint files in drive b!abc123def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e31f6ac7f25f187f6ad074da6f988997e"><em>Show the first 50 files in drive b!abc123def456 and then get the next page of results.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="efa8115a20ca0b0bd71a96eb1044405d6"><em>Browse the Marketing folder in my SharePoint drive and show me all PDF files.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>microsoft_onedrive_list_drives</code> – Lists OneDrive and SharePoint drives available to a user or within a SharePoint site.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eceb278e411821325813e841dc96e20fc">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e95a0e73796848a77d07434d6b7e83907">Discover all drives available to a specific user.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5c7f768b83ef1b551dd8a8c08891e76a">Retrieve the drives associated with a SharePoint site.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e770d875be13dc8d5f9645f32f095af6a">Find drive IDs needed for browsing drive contents with other tools.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9f63c6a563b585ce8b97c0c867e86e62">Identify available document libraries before navigating or searching files.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e4e23f1b36932680a4455b2ddbcb49383">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ea6ff59c3c6449f130a914bcfcc2104d6">(Optional) <code>userId</code> – The ID of the user to list drives for. Use <code>me</code> for the currently authenticated user.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee6f3d645f03cfc27305a460e60a8aca8">(Optional) <code>siteId</code> – The ID of a SharePoint site to list drives for.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="efe285415bced15bba44a721036e8aced">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed2804908cd10f50ca4a5998cfecb88bb"><em>List all drives available to me.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e6eac47ea0a7e71fa479eaaf3d419f632"><em>Show me all the drives for user john.doe@example.com.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="edcfe02dd2c2493e322d62fa5b05047eb"><em>What drives are available on the SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e336dc454be6ebda822e5b288119eb769"><em>Get all document libraries for my SharePoint site so I can browse the files.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>microsoft_onedrive_modify_office_file</code> – Modifies an existing Microsoft Office file stored in OneDrive or SharePoint.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e3fc213aed4cce21bf58cbd4a9941e3d1">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb04de9fd1bc0ac8051d9238bde6b5cdc">Replace specific text in a Word document or specific cell values in an Excel spreadsheet.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed3084adc9302146e81d31ba634922561">Append new content to the end of a document or add new rows to the bottom of a spreadsheet.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebb7158c8b453d22a2cd7845119473817">Prepend content to the beginning of a document or rows to the top of an Excel file.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3f8007541b946b2b73f30e655a710338">Insert new content at a specific paragraph index or row index.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e22343d52314600d4134f58195f9cad16">Apply uniform formatting (for example, font size, color, or bold) across an entire Word document.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ebcd9a1085e8efcaed39558a60ef1a0bd">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e8e861954be0a1498e7fb39287c03723d">
<code>itemId</code> – The unique identifier of the Office file to modify.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0bac8d6f8f72fad3370f5231932ad5cf">
<code>operation</code> – Operation to perform. Options include the following: <code>replace</code>, <code>append</code>, <code>prepend</code>, <code>insert</code>, or <code>format</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0907f47998c32b05dc8916d9dd2d7adf">(Optional) <code>content</code> – Content to add. <ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e4a83daabb6e768ba27e7d771dffd1956">For <code>docx</code> – Supports markdown formatting. </li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0dd188a957ebceef1f3bb08d5c2d8e13">For <code>xlsx</code> – Supports newline-separated rows.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef838bd6f981df8ec348b1bf3ec9aca17">(Optional) <code>driveId</code> – Drive ID where the file is located.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e74a4afc0a3d96dfaf5e0d04d1b1d7c78">(Optional) <code>formatting</code> – Formatting options as JSON string (<code>docx</code> only, for format operation). This replaces all existing formatting uniformly. For example, <code>{"bold": true, "italic": false, "fontSize": 14, "color": "blue"}</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2340d08e5e00abfa1a358d760e5f6275">(Optional) <code>position</code> – Paragraph index (<code>docx</code>) or row index (<code>xlsx</code>) at which to insert content (required for insert operation).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e18e6df88274b9a7d1864d012ae8955c1">(Optional) <code>replaceText</code> – Replacement text (required for replace operation).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea3114b11f725d76005a3226053591faf">(Optional) <code>searchText</code> – Text to search for (required for replace operation).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edaddd54d4c1902d7599588321e008d74">(Optional) <code>siteId</code> – SharePoint site ID where the file is located.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e061d2116af75c8357fc92027431fda92">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="efea46a197b6279f1544f8ceccdfd0b08"><em>Append the following new user data rows to the end of my Excel spreadsheet.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e88bfbd32c477b52d63031f29a3b3a64d"><em>Find all occurrences of "Acme Corp" in the Word document and replace them with "Globex Corporation".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5c54590b595061c6ff07c1514b81602e"><em>Insert this new introductory paragraph at position 1 in the existing project proposal document.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>microsoft_onedrive_summarize_office_file</code> – Generates a summary of a Microsoft Office file's content and metadata.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e7619014ff1b47c6cd85cfa155fa1c55e">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e1bc529b01867490228b7940ddb3d675d">Get a quick overview or extract core themes and topics from a Word document.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea7d7f7970859892bc77e14041483b384">Analyze an Excel file to retrieve sheet names, row counts, and previews of data.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e923e392f935d0c4427d627468ee7536e">Generate a structured bullet-point breakdown or a detailed comprehensive analysis without opening the file.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e218c17e71797c907272a51ec9cdb720c">Check file metadata such as author name, modification dates, and size.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e89d5336c119db4474ac47b8fbc14f172">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e2e1f346eb3547f3a9b87a8bc2091f916">
<code>itemId</code> – The unique identifier of the Office file to summarize.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9dd22eff1cf3abe6320ec6e739a0351e">(Optional) <code>driveId</code> – Drive ID where the file is located.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3e444c49018329f5c2c3ad201dc5d498">(Optional) <code>maxLength</code> – Maximum length of the summary in characters. Default is <code>500</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e884d6f1ecca1dbed0856c8012c0e7117">(Optional) <code>siteId</code> – SharePoint site ID where the file is located.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0474e2e6c4565990fe0e367e57d31f8c">(Optional) <code>summaryType</code> – Type of summary. Options include the following:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e7a08917747cbe25558c36a9a9ccb71ed">
<code>brief</code> – Quick overview, default.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e485e2cca860830e37c5af5cc9775349c">
<code>detailed</code> – Comprehensive analysis.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3868d0c046ff33374cd521420d8eab1e">
<code>bullet-points</code> – Structured list.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ebb123ee931d205a457df7c837c4f6fb3">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb04ed0c8352374c978f031ca37abfd25"><em>Can you read the "Q3 Financials" Excel file and give me a brief summary of the data and sheet structures?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e2ac8dcb67870002d670b558a20be2438"><em>Provide a detailed summary of the strategy document in bullet points, keeping it under 1000 characters.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e769bed66533804de911a50f005988083"><em>Summarize the main topics discussed in the attached SharePoint Word document.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>onedrive_create_folder</code> – Create a new folder in OneDrive or Sharepoint. If the folder already exists, the tool returns the existing folder without creating a duplicate.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e1b9f1517c5682b9458a50253e080b206">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e0c9e5864c75204363ea31556b5fcf26e">Create a new folder in your Onedrive.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebefa7e501ca64a2454e0968e4359c409">Create a subfolder inside an existing folder.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8f7d8f08a9deda352f0e69525844e4f8">Organize files by creating folder structures</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6baeb302ba942396ac2422a988c4b0cc">Create project or team folders in Sharepoint document libraries.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eb9c0ec8e4673fd9d83e29ff1452a6a6c">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e8987f3f1b1714a2003eb35f4426ae251">
<code>folderName</code> – The name of the folder to create. Cannot contain <code>\</code>,  <code>/</code>, <code>:</code>, <code>*</code>, <code>?</code>, <code>"</code>, <code><</code>, or <code>></code>. </li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4b46cc5f03857f0053102f1c6b11d477">
<code>driveId</code> – The ID of the drive to create the folder in. Use <code>onedrive_list_drives</code> or <code>onedrive_list_all</code> to find drive IDs.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e24510c346c1bd56b8884b2ebc58b0c2f">(Optional) <code>parentPath</code> – Path to the parent folder where the new folder is created. Example: <code>Documents/Projects</code>. If omitted (and <code>parentId</code> is also omitted), creates the folder at the drive root.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3da4b8ab52ea32a6582bcbe1db5822cb">(Optional) <code>parentId</code> – The item ID of the parent folder. Use this instead of <code>parentPath</code> if you already have the folder ID. Takes precedence over <code>parentPath</code> if both are provided.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e3575b09426b1b53fa9ae0f38da5a3d86">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul data-axiom="1.9.38">
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-axiom="1.9.38" data-list-item-id="e1d0f81cd5605bfd558220ff5593bef6d"><em>Create a new folder in my OneDrive called 'Q3 Marketing Assets'.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-axiom="1.9.38" data-list-item-id="e956c55ee8cf837fd95a62f6098212608"><em>Can you make a folder named 'Campaign Reports' in my OneDrive?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-axiom="1.9.38" data-list-item-id="e788d62defabed236f7387587efbccddc"><em>Please create a new OneDrive folder titled '2026 Budget Drafts'.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-axiom="1.9.38" data-list-item-id="e40841e845932caba86a4d996cc5bce4d"><em>I need a new directory in my OneDrive for the 'Summer Launch' project.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-axiom="1.9.38" data-list-item-id="ee300fb8f112ac2886c4f34d06d3474d3"><em>Create a folder named 'Client Presentations' in my OneDrive.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h3 id="h_01KMDMWAW1QB34VERWQHFHMM4C">Microsoft SharePoint tools<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KMDMWAW1QB34VERWQHFHMM4C"></a></h3><details><summary><code>microsoft_sharepoint_find_list</code> – Finds a SharePoint list or document library by name within a specific SharePoint site.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e92405a43d5e32e265ce61a113b6df4aa">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ed5281f31323e7550c527ad76eeaac31e">Look up the ID of a specific SharePoint list or document library by its display name.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e06f91116ad90a87442caae5224ac3eff">Locate a document library such as "Site Pages" or "Documents" before accessing its contents.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8cb12359efbc09c4bc0b0d1d02d77f27">Verify that a list exists within a SharePoint site before performing further operations.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e277c1191eab53b633dce93be0ab3e908">Retrieve list metadata including creation date, URL, and template type.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e64fdf33723cc96dc0120c3a1f66315cc">Discover all available lists within a site when the target list name is unknown.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e050fb797c3da12929da07b439fcf0efb">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e881510004b6de753ef3aa6d9e369560a">
<code>siteId</code> – The unique identifier of the SharePoint site to search within. Format: <code>hostname,site-collection-id,site-id</code> (for example, <code>contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e61f3bc3b749796880f2fc397368975ec">
<code>listName</code> – The display name of the SharePoint list or document library to find (for example, <code>Site Pages</code>, <code>Documents</code>, or <code>Site Assets</code>).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e0f167229df534ba1f59f0305a6f80c8b">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e959d44d5b9e9f33948cf4ad94f483a8a"><em>Find the "Site Pages" library in my SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eae1405faff25d710ccc8f37ccd925943"><em>Look up the list ID for "Project Documents" in SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e11a02c92d4894b7d84ade3332453d658"><em>Does a list called "Marketing Assets" exist in SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eccdbb0b9e0bacff5c14e077024890bf1"><em>Find the "Documents" library in my SharePoint site so I can browse its files.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e13c3f624cb56d4eda85d6ca02a4573db"><em>Get the metadata for the "Site Assets" library in SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>microsoft_sharepoint_find_site_page</code> – Finds a SharePoint site page by name and retrieves its page ID and metadata.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e6f5df43358328d396afe020afec57f8b">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e583f1305ba9137e116abbde27c19a2dd">Resolve a SharePoint page name to a page ID before retrieving its content.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2897aac72089fef515f2f028fc47e28c">Check whether a specific page exists within a SharePoint site.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef7e90f7ea285b1af6d15bb4c1a519a96">Retrieve basic metadata about a page, such as its URL and last modified date, without fetching its full content.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9e4fb0a3bf9381274517b7ca39880136">Look up a page ID to use with other tools that require it as an input.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8cf5f2908572233cc7dd794caaae4c44">Find a site's home page or any custom page by name.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e5a626632de35753ee5a49cfd6049326c">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e2826ff99dc78c0ba3dee944694bf888c">
<code>siteId</code> – The unique identifier of the SharePoint site containing the page. Format: <code>hostname,site-collection-id,site-id</code> (for example, <code>contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ead8a9bba128ac08ccf0abc33ee642b93">
<code>pageName</code> – The name of the page to find. Can be provided with or without the <code>.aspx</code> extension (for example, <code>Home</code> or <code>Home.aspx</code>).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e15fd2b37cc645082fd23913812b90843">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e788e1cb6bd97e07aa0521d723a41f036"><em>Find the "Home" page in my SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5d52f236831b665b3414aaee9507386a"><em>Get the page ID for "Visiting-the-Austin-office.aspx" in SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e020002d5d9138d58788d38d66843a31c"><em>Does a page called "ProjectOverview" exist in SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ee7b21295debfcf88dbf76aeff3aa3762"><em>Look up the metadata for the "TeamPage" page in my SharePoint site.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eea8e1255754e9444676130e94be515c3"><em>Find the page ID for the home page of SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456 so I can retrieve its content.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>microsoft_sharepoint_get_page_content</code> – Retrieves the raw HTML content of a specific SharePoint site page.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e124b3aae9565b3b41da1991731badf01">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb49c0e42fd4e30b7415d90857f15d880">Read and extract the content of a SharePoint page for summarization or analysis.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebfc0e5bc37132d4ae643577ce98750b9">Retrieve the full HTML of a page for content migration or archival purposes.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8feccb4c59992d95bca50947f9b0762c">Access page metadata such as URL and last modified date alongside its content.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec5a537a53c787898c9171b2e855da94e">Pull content from a SharePoint knowledge base page for further processing.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e95876263e75e77e1988008087f99f756">Copy content from one SharePoint page to use elsewhere.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef85a6db3a69381c85ddd21d1e8619719">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e411bd73a80f269d2c1b5b5a9276a88e2">
<code>siteId</code> – The unique identifier of the SharePoint site containing the page. Format: <code>hostname,site-collection-id,site-id</code> (for example, <code>contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e474133cbcf074b3a89057a4f7b8dfa59">
<code>pageName</code> – The name of the SharePoint page to retrieve. Can be provided with or without the <code>.aspx</code> extension (for example, <code>Home</code> or <code>Home.aspx</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec6ad420ef252b6f20ecc86a49eaf00c0">(Optional) <code>listId</code> – The ID of the SharePoint list containing the page. If not provided, the tool will automatically find the "Site Pages" library. Providing this can improve performance.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e7ca1b725af7eb08621db26b461b810f2">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e325af8526e8fe4a86e96d9ca622be6bb"><em>Get the content of the "Home" page from SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed57d51dc8be5493a4dca4be9cf243a01"><em>Summarize the content of the "ProjectOverview.aspx" page in my SharePoint site.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ea8b4bad0031b715bf882d11c5df09b22"><em>Retrieve the HTML content of the "TeamPage" page from SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e68d14364de96594487110eb8fff76662"><em>What does the "Onboarding" page say in my SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ea7c89673de3619a77b638e4f8992eb97"><em>Pull the content from the "Marketing Strategy" page in SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456 so I can copy it into a document.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>microsoft_sharepoint_get_site</code> – Retrieves detailed information about a specific SharePoint site.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e0bff38d139997953a9920f7a4200ddad">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e9b660282db2bfce8795fe34b8bdbcf7a">Look up metadata and properties for a specific SharePoint site.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e625b9d98de28f2ac616204b38eb27d4d">Retrieve a site ID needed for use with other SharePoint tools.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb034376a083971a4f50dcdb34e08b361">Access a SharePoint site using its hostname and server-relative path.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9089b98e984a00e3e9b84fc57935103d">Get information about the root site of a SharePoint tenant.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e41d40a40b6acf8951dd1f734f2685629">Verify a site exists and retrieve its URL before browsing its contents or pages.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="efda351626820ab8f49e01d23c795028a">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e87965ab76d8aa01c173143e6e94222c3">(Optional) <code>siteId</code> – The unique identifier of the SharePoint site. Format: <code>hostname,site-collection-id,site-id</code> (for example, <code>contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e84dba7320f8577945b509c9911d64bf9">(Optional) <code>hostname</code> – The hostname of the SharePoint tenant (for example, <code>contoso.sharepoint.com</code>). Can be used with or without <code>sitePath</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e52498db17b4474a0f67701be13748ef3">(Optional) <code>sitePath</code> – The server-relative path of the site (for example, <code>/sites/projectsite</code>). Must be used together with <code>hostname</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eec4032744a6da77ae356a0dcc1322ed3">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed81610aceaea9b90d914801aec1d5382"><em>Get details about the SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ecb3fbe6d00e175170385226eee89b92c"><em>Retrieve information about the root SharePoint site at contoso.sharepoint.com.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e18ab8c19f11b8d98df85924b81f2798e"><em>Get the site ID and URL for the SharePoint site at contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/marketing.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb44acdc53d8af9c4d73729a386ace52c"><em>Show me the metadata for the SharePoint site at contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/projectsite.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec02341e78ab27dbe8f0baee774fa6bb6"><em>Find the SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456 so I can browse its document libraries.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>microsoft_sharepoint_get_site_page_structured_content</code> – Retrieves structured content from a SharePoint site page, including all web parts and their content in an organized format.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eeee1b5bc360b56603670f962cf7e8404">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e779fcb2b9248772aa4a9e18a7be1450e">Retrieve clean, structured content from a modern SharePoint page for summarization or analysis.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edcc8dbccc59a32a378a198a3dc0dc36f">Extract text from all web parts on a page without parsing raw HTML.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9d916c972cf6798f6efb2ed6c2cea2e4">Access the full canvas layout of a SharePoint page, including sections and web part structure.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e60c4bd1b5960bc38f39aeaf4c986e079">Pull content from a SharePoint knowledge base or intranet page for further processing.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eaa8cc979ad88c5dc2aa1ad2a4d23d635">Generate a report or summary from the content of a specific SharePoint page.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e8dbbf6485767042e680d587c878a595e">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e215b82d896a0c1da5c7e70bf3bfcc743">
<code>siteId</code> – The unique identifier of the SharePoint site containing the page. Format: <code>hostname,site-collection-id,site-id</code> (for example, <code>contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebd22758cfb58039be294b557224846fa">(Optional) <code>pageName</code> – The name of the SharePoint page to retrieve. Can be provided with or without the <code>.aspx</code> extension (for example, <code>Home</code> or <code>Home.aspx</code>). Required if <code>pageId</code> is not provided.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0ec4e6138adf58f513baed5d031f9d02">(Optional) <code>pageId</code> – The unique identifier of the SharePoint page. Required if <code>pageName</code> is not provided. Can be retrieved using the <code>microsoft_sharepoint_find_site_page</code> tool.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ee4d0569be7a848a3c6ffd42256cd3f03">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec1bb147aca07a0ebfa4adb2a43713249"><em>Get the structured content of the "Home" page from SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e7ba7fe840926c73da77b6d3ad141228c"><em>Summarize the content of the "Onboarding.aspx" page in my SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e39050cd49029f4f178054291fdda5669"><em>Retrieve and extract the text from all web parts on the "Marketing Strategy" page in SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eadbb87800f05998e593c89273c86d19e"><em>Get the structured layout of SharePoint page b1234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef in site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e41912b94fe8a8905b51c76cb8954ddc8"><em>What does the "Company News" page say in my SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456?</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>microsoft_sharepoint_list_site_contents</code> – Lists files and folders in a SharePoint site's document library or list.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e8df7c257a7f294f4f64d04930178527e">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e9495f5f9be8ece8fc4ac38605a116c8e">Browse files and folders within a SharePoint site's default document library.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebc2589c1f61d382bf0408b2ff5446705">Go to a specific SharePoint list or library by providing its ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7ab69d34f7478b5ef35d4de2fe2cb6bf">Filter site contents by file type to find specific documents.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9e44530688368ce5ef8a7d907fbb6baf">Paginate through large SharePoint libraries with many files or subfolders.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec49e8ed07103ab210ac2ae9f577f68e2">Retrieve file metadata such as size, URL, and last modified date from a SharePoint site.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e774d8734dc27e396a0e6ead17159f56c">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ed5658272654a9450d7f4519352050162">
<code>siteId</code> – The unique identifier of the SharePoint site. Format: <code>hostname,site-collection-id,site-id</code> (for example, <code>contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1a4fcfca63ae665be92fa2b97641dfb1">(Optional) <code>listId</code> – The ID of a specific list or library to access. If not provided, uses the site's default document library.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e43e007eaeb4d3b4f55c606cff4d03700">(Optional) <code>folderPath</code> – Path to a specific folder within the library (for example, <code>/Documents/Projects</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb334c98a3698b04c02ed6d1ec98acf1f">(Optional) <code>folderId</code> – The ID of a specific folder to list contents of. Can be used as an alternative to <code>folderPath</code>.</li>
