<li data-list-item-id="efbf57723483b9370c398387030ad02e8">(Optional) <code>fileType</code> – MIME type to filter results by (for example, <code>application/pdf</code>). Returns only files matching this type.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e210dd9526db6242289c8a0c1100d695f">(Optional) <code>top</code> – Maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 200.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e50ed21915daa7f2107e7cc3a9c52bec1">(Optional) <code>skip</code> – Number of items to skip for pagination.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eed072d195e7070cdaae17d80bdde935e">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed504ba66c9a685291974fa8c34c0b02f"><em>List all files in the default document library of SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e7c17b9cfcc7c48238cf0c1bfaf627ac7"><em>Show me the contents of the Documents/Projects folder in SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e72d0bd2498c0e5f4b2d617152bf6d29d"><em>List only the PDF files in the SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e2a54bac952b2f6e1f69cab9f89990c89"><em>Browse the contents of library b57af081-936c-4803-a120-d94887dc6c05 in my SharePoint site.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e3adee1ca0bf057f9dd3574733477b741"><em>Show me the first 50 files in SharePoint site contoso.sharepoint.com,abc123,def456 and then get the next page.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>microsoft_sharepoint_list_sites</code> – Lists SharePoint sites accessible to the authenticated user.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eaf3c01f181f0f60e9e3225a9a713950a">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e93ec856a3c90061f43cb8facad214d54">Discover all SharePoint sites available to the current user.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7e2c49ec128cb980ec66c3afb25cfa9f">Search for a specific SharePoint site by name or keyword.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e98b8af4691d64088468b7950b5b161fe">Retrieve site IDs needed for use with other SharePoint tools.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee0502d0c913afdffcfe566ce40e3c357">Paginate through a large number of SharePoint sites in an organization.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef8341e45598e877759a6dbe383eac861">Audit available SharePoint sites before browsing their contents or pages.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef7169ace834ac65ebf769f84dcf22015">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e5d5aa6efeaab7a1abc6c5b567833a728">(Optional) <code>search</code> – Search query to find sites by name or content (for example, <code>marketing</code>). Returns all sites if not specified.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4457694817ff0cb8ac509d15212c88cf">(Optional) <code>filter</code> – OData filter expression to narrow results (for example, <code>siteCollection/hostname eq 'contoso.sharepoint.com'</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb0c67dcb6a8dcb7247ee462a221903d0">(Optional) <code>orderBy</code> – Field to sort results by (for example, <code>displayName</code> or <code>createdDateTime</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eae641fc718086303a2cd49dfe4f6fcfd">(Optional) <code>top</code> – Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 25, max 1000.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e64299efa53c87fa8df359917b9b15894">(Optional) <code>skip</code> – Number of results to skip for pagination.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ecb0a581be8357adaf897f47e7c87ee91">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e82fa159879aa8ebdd9a1890adf57704b"><em>List all SharePoint sites I have access to.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e889ac58f993d9ee255849684ae9d4897"><em>Find all SharePoint sites with "marketing" in the name.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed94ed37e784328da607c6e898e0935ee"><em>Show me the top 50 SharePoint sites in my organization, sorted by display name.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ef253a2be318cdcad78124cc2c69a2a29"><em>List all SharePoint sites on contoso.sharepoint.com.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ea4ca1ada6af5c0a66567f8a01391ff33"><em>Find the SharePoint site for the sales team so I can browse its files.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h3 id="h_01KT72NCXB89P1CXVZRS2RCVHW">Outlook Email tools<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KT72NCXB89P1CXVZRS2RCVHW"></a></h3><details><summary><code>outlook_get_manager</code> – Get a user's manager from the organizational hierarchy.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="edeefb3fd849cede5bcae491159fca432">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e0bf97ebacb751501654ef96b95552f71">Find who someone's manager is.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed1989feddfba10f86f19d0e31b287a6d">Look up the authenticated user's own manager.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec473db04faeb5284ca233231a30d581d">Get manager contact details (name, email, or job title).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e4fed23b1f2273addff500e909c88d830">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul><li data-list-item-id="ed5b6ea32f1bf13756b523b997a0201fc">(Optional) <code>userId</code> – The user ID (GUID) or email address of the person whose manager to retrieve. If omitted, returns the authenticated user's manager. Example: "john.doe@company.com" or "a1b2c3d4-...".</li></ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ec5566e2be6647846ea157a652c7730e2">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec86cadc4c5ae2e23293f894c90fa1b2a"><em>Who is my manager?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="efa5014f81456b7fd8c368180e276a350"><em>Can you tell me who John Doe reports to?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="edc7e20f3371f42302cac5cd0b3938406"><em>Get the manager for john.doe@company.com.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_mail_create_draft</code> – Create a draft email in the user's Microsoft Outlook Drafts folder without sending it.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e7d0f006e3fdea03bccff7fa6620f25e1">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ebbce700bbe47e49ddd4333afc005855f">Create draft emails for later review and sending.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e687c2df3edfbcb8cb7cc43f321d877d2">Prepare emails the user wants to edit before sending.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6afb1250fae800b98516152a97b21ca8">Save email compositions without sending them.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef99b0d60632a23f8990aa8c3c35b5e69">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e4f0554488dce490c8d93bc6403f8d536">
<code>subject</code> – The subject line of the draft email.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e69c0c63aadc344bc412896a9b6494c32">(Optional) <code>bccRecipients</code> – List of BCC recipients as a JSON string array. Same format as <code>toRecipients</code>. Provide as a JSON string (Python-style with single quotes is supported).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eec1b37a4effa90ce1b7f683f7dd20fd3">(Optional) <code>body</code> – Alias for <code>bodyContent</code>. The email body content, plain text or HTML. Use <code>bodyContent</code> instead when possible.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2aafb1adab2c1eba50f27d2b68beaae2">(Optional) <code>bodyContent</code> – The email body content, plain text or HTML. For plain text: "Hi team, here is the update." For HTML: "<h1>Title</h1><p>Body paragraph</p>".</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e106e1ef26cfd5d9f8509d00bab7ae6e7">(Optional) <code>bodyContentType</code> – Content type of the email body. Values: <code>Text</code> or <code>HTML</code>. Default: <code>Text</code>. Set to <code>HTML</code> when <code>bodyContent</code> contains HTML markup.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e005604dc3104d2e7a66aac696d8d099b">(Optional) <code>ccRecipients</code> – List of CC recipients as a JSON string array. Same format as <code>toRecipients</code>. Provide as a JSON string (Python-style with single quotes is supported).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efddea655612acace24b474859c28a6e3">(Optional) <code>importance</code> – Importance level of the email. Values: <code>low</code>, <code>normal</code>, or <code>high</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2349592aa09b079711dcac1b054f3ac2">(Optional) <code>toRecipients</code> – List of primary recipients as a JSON string array. Single recipient: <code>[{'emailAddress': {'address': 'user@company.com'}}]</code>. With name: <code>[{'emailAddress': {'name': 'John Doe', 'address': 'john@company.com'}}]</code>. Provide as a JSON string (Python-style with single quotes is supported).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e8926b2d6578c83c0804def84c4b92d96">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eae4578c8c08192c50ab6d72b216a0134"><em>Draft an email to the marketing team about the Q4 report.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e1e686766c08f0968f587012cc41302ab"><em>Prepare a draft email to John about the project update but don't send it yet.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e4c532a410a16060a8ba955c52525732d"><em>Save a draft email titled "Budget 2026" with a summary of our meeting notes.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_mail_create_draft_reply</code> – Create a draft reply to an email message in Microsoft Outlook without sending it.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e4baed2bcd517241e93fefc928db2a310">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e1e4e926c1fe3b81e667a5cd1561241c3">Draft a reply for the user to review before sending.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3b8e2df431be17469ceeeed11432eea4">Prepare a reply that needs editing or approval.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3193f6e0f3212f52d3a9ffa4e0da70a6">Create a reply the user wants to finish later in Outlook.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ebc2f63695e516736b86cf6df35046299">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e76209d1f22af1f336481d20add166aaa">
<code>messageId</code> – The unique identifier of the email message to reply to. Use <code>outlook_mail_list</code> or <code>outlook_mail_get</code> to find the message ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec8bdee5b7b9bc2859824817595a1e86d">(Optional) <code>ccRecipients</code> – Optional CC recipients as a JSON string array. Same format as <code>toRecipients</code>. Provide as a JSON string (Python-style with single quotes is supported).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7d6c4fcdcbfce26270992f709da17804">(Optional) <code>comment</code> – The reply body content, plain text or HTML. If omitted, creates an empty draft reply to fill in later.<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e742983c5a7380c08021a109edfeff629">
<strong>For plain text</strong>: – "Thanks, I will review and get back to you." </li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebdf9c6baa1744edf30be561e899c2860">
<strong>For HTML</strong> – "<p>Thank you.</p><p>I have questions:</p>".</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecb1621d4fb7b26e11397323506c79017">(Optional) <code>confirmNonInbox</code> – Set to true only after you have explicitly confirmed you want to create a draft reply to a message that is not in the Inbox (for example Sent Items or Drafts). </li>
<li data-list-item-id="ead2160d3aea0500b0940d888a753f373">(Optional) <code>toRecipients</code> – Optional override recipients as a JSON string array. If not provided, the reply goes to the original sender. Format: "[{'emailAddress': {'address': 'user@company.com'}}]". Provide as a JSON string (Python-style with single quotes is supported).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e65ba8f9e851832cdbf0ead2d370df4e7">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed3832fc988e42d01dda07d04b8bc6469"><em>Draft a reply to the last email from Sarah saying I approve the proposal.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e7a21564c671c7fca0528fe2e7967eef6"><em>Start a draft reply to that email so I can add my comments later.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e1a2847f1e52b9a5cbae377f4e6f5656c"><em>Prepare a draft response to the budget thread and copy John.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_mail_forward</code> – Forward an email message to new recipients in Microsoft Outlook.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e244a94ed9537182e523a8716edc44496">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef6a137bd24f6e59fc1d820517f450264">Forward an email to one or more new recipients.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed2bf1a6238af20eaf9c405bc3318458c">Share email information with colleagues.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e84eb7e288bbef15343ad59470e9082f4">Add a comment when forwarding.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e86e2655ebcdbd3c540ca17501304aed7">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e1972b88a8f5ba1ea27aacbea94b0c79a">
<code>messageId</code> – The unique identifier of the email message to forward.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e957999c8ee4827426e33c2251c642267">
<code>toRecipients</code> – List of recipients to forward to as a JSON string array. Provide as a JSON string (Python-style with single quotes is supported).<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e930396c5594772c6b2f86dc08a91def5">
<strong>Single recipient</strong> – "[{'emailAddress': {'address': 'user@company.com'}}]". </li>
<li data-list-item-id="e78ee08a710e907e6d7e467f1c5e86d31">
<strong>Multiple</strong> – "[{'emailAddress': {'address': 'a@co.com'}}, {'emailAddress': {'address': 'b@co.com'}}]". </li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efad7a4260f7e431c951a457d7b042da9">(Optional) <code>comment</code> – Comment to include with the forwarded message. Supports HTML formatting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eeb69cce8d48cb388f4e40e61da3bb40d">(Optional) <code>confirmNonInbox</code> – Set to true only after you have explicitly confirmed you want to forward a message that is not in the Inbox (for example Sent Items or Drafts).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eb384c0bd768030300b16ee7a94341b39">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="edede6bc7d5f421fda099dfb5f0eb84ed"><em>Forward the latest project update email to the design team.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eea3258de4328651331977b42287eb661"><em>Please forward this message to bob@company.com with the note "FYI".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec739dcfd42712acda6e7898115b08168"><em>Can you forward the Q3 results email to my manager?</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_mail_get_message</code> – Get a specific email message from Microsoft Outlook by its ID.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ec0d46cddc08e5416f6abff51c9c8d342">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e8609266b92047831f9b5c2209ac4d30d">Read the full content of a specific email.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e179fa2fa8f5cacc5f2a04ee8c5d64aae">Get detailed email headers and metadata.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea287afa2ac5cdbec891040cb8292ac54">View attachment details (name, type, or size) on an email.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef3890ba1343b7c5b7a06117634e2e90e">Access the full HTML or text body of a message.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e52577626b34056a64945a9d8302fe36f">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e687df541c3573513b97cf839e32dede7">
<code>messageId</code> – The unique identifier of the email message to retrieve.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efa008b0d710a3250be2dfeb7204271db">(Optional) <code>expand</code> – Comma-separated list of related entities to expand. For example: "attachments".</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2430ca449e8b8befd63bbf399d99fa32">(Optional) <code>select</code> – Comma-separated list of fields to return. For example: "subject,from,body,receivedDateTime,toRecipients".</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e1b56d4d617b240fb17f6372fee1a6c71">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ecf2a5557fd7e34baac2e4403d48cf1f6"><em>Read the full email thread about the contract review.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb2422251eb887c7455f0b22532cc8ead"><em>Get the details and attachments for the latest email from legal.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ebfccf0a885ac00d9a9561ef37d23d6bf"><em>Show me the full text of the welcome email I just received.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_mail_list_folders</code> – List mail folders for the authenticated user with unread counts.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e8ba986e10b690e9e6833ab9eec23f4c6">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e386b5fa6116b8b9d4e5b33dc03834076">Check how many unread emails are in the inbox.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e22da7e4d2ff0f7a95e8c90673eb87066">Browse the user's mail folder structure.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7e5e1e2a340b27efb690a7c8fd94cfed">Get unread counts across all folders.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea94e03d224c92eaedf01d0b276075277">Find folder IDs for use with other mail tools.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e4d33e66f1bae2c84830ee3d154d33b24">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e2262f71705ad628fc1d4bfb0b6a2c963">(Optional) <code>includeHiddenFolders</code> – Whether to include hidden mail folders (default: false).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5b7d110c5a3beb3f8c24b1e0b878e499">(Optional) <code>skip</code> – Number of folders to skip for pagination.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e98566cba62567f824c85bde3792b3e89">(Optional) <code>top</code> – Maximum number of folders to return.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e7690e281482103d59642bfe1c05b3334">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eda0633c9534a57cbfbf7c0b717061166"><em>Show me a list of all my email folders.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e564127717438317abdb73137f94969e5"><em>How many unread emails are in my inbox?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e64927ece8228ec2c014267d9b4e67df6"><em>Can you list my custom mail folders?</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_mail_list_messages</code> – List and search email messages from Microsoft Outlook.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e342b71527e302feedd8457c90b523d02">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e3454ac10f24ae43810330a9462fbad4c">Search emails by keyword (full-text search across subject, body, and sender).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb98cb5b48388dcb93c6b14be75fd5527">List recent emails in the inbox or a specific folder.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2bfd67129823deefd93692bb967b0219">Filter emails by sender, date, read status, importance, and so on.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e444ad2eb89c8759dd349e4bfec1fc76e">Paginate through large sets of email messages.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e6294ba3a7770bece4d811c4f0a79e6f1">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef2ebe606b52809690f8b9a05219eb2ee">(Optional) <code>filter</code> – Open Data Protocol (OData) filter expression for property-based filtering. Examples: <code>isRead eq false</code>, <code>importance eq 'high'</code>, <code>from/emailAddress/address eq 'john@company.com'</code>, and <code>receivedDateTime ge 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z</code>. Cannot be combined with the <code>search</code> parameter.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e076d6c9e7c6f0b1e2692e13098bf0913">(Optional) <code>folderId</code> – ID or well-known name of the mail folder to list from. Well-known names: <code>inbox</code>, <code>drafts</code>, <code>sentitems</code>, <code>deleteditems</code>, <code>junkemail</code>, and <code>archive</code>. If not specified, lists from all mail folders.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e82850d23824c3ce70db1cfc4fd985e00">(Optional) <code>orderBy</code> – Field to order results by (for example, <code>receivedDateTime desc</code>, <code>subject asc</code>). Cannot be used with the <code>search</code> parameter. When searching, results are ranked by relevance automatically.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e780899af7ec3b5ba7f62b259653f61c6">(Optional) <code>search</code> – Full-text search query using Kusto Query Language (KQL) syntax. Searches across subject, body, and sender. Example: <code>project proposal</code> or <code>from:john@company.com</code>. Cannot be combined with the <code>filter</code> parameter.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3ec52cc9443eb42101bca2d9ef264f02">(Optional) <code>select</code> – Comma-separated list of fields to return (for example, <code>subject,from,receivedDateTime,bodyPreview,isRead</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee968a17f36ebeb735f65f6dc39f4e24f">(Optional) <code>skip</code> – Number of messages to skip for pagination.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2d92aa6895f82a2a00c690347760ac1a">(Optional) <code>top</code> – Maximum number of messages to return (default: 25, max: 999).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e8b646af602691857de11adc9113c1d3e">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ef542daa41b8cd7a757475f16807a34a0"><em>Search my emails for the "project proposal".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eeee259a5df7b7852af3c37ac2d222173"><em>Show me my latest unread emails.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e8321d184eb76f826007912cc9accadf9"><em>List the 10 most recent emails from john@company.com.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_mail_reply</code> – Reply to an email message in Microsoft Outlook.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ede20a75932b503744f8624b0c234c151">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eab0c08801c06d3e7acfdc95f80f7a297">Reply to a specific email message.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7ccfcd9c54601a5e81c782a259e6d00a">Continue an email conversation thread.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6d318a9e21ecf8cf049255277d6a26e4">Optionally override the reply recipients.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e72e937846a1a88fe3037f2e06b4b1a69">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ee575f3afb32d3c40af920cb8fb3a51fe">
<code>comment</code> – The reply text or body content. Supports HTML formatting. Example: "Thanks for the update, I will review and get back to you."</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edb949cd0ab9f54f9e8de9e44c97a8c7a">
<code>messageId</code> – The unique identifier of the email message to reply to.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e33487e36fc4cb69f6c40dffca6e477d1">(Optional) <code>confirmNonInbox</code> – Set to true only after you have explicitly confirmed you want to reply to a message that is not in the Inbox (for example Sent Items, or Drafts).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e700e2bad94176fb35980dc41e9eca96d">(Optional) <code>toRecipients</code> – Override recipients as a JSON string array. If not provided, the reply goes to the original sender. Format: <code>[{'emailAddress': {'address': 'user@company.com'}}]</code>. Provide as a JSON string (Python-style with single quotes is supported).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e1e2bca239587b4971878446564da9174">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e6bb1972e6db9bb0c62c0ebd80ecdd7bc"><em>Reply to the last email from Sarah saying "Thanks for the update".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e60a8d08a583119476077909c5afa155d"><em>Send a reply to the contract thread confirming my approval.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e24eee4e47639b3ae44bf3934f7e217e9"><em>Reply to John's email and copy the rest of the team.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_mail_send</code> – Send a new email from the user's Microsoft Outlook account.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea425f75cae41b5bbf992d83529f5c5ba">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e59af91cff537d70a6f6e3357a5dbc33e">Send new emails to one or more recipients from your Outlook.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e141b3ff66b4f9968c10c5dbf0156c134">Compose emails with HTML or plain text body.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4fc1d9d6d5078a5eafb22a2244a013fc">Send emails with CC and BCC recipients.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9d356492ab2891fe9300d8ae2a49cfeb">Set email importance level.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed7ff8dccaf2d4414321d0f19255215be">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e11f8fe13dbc3975dde4e23db0db92138">
<code>subject</code> – The subject line of the email.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e33c0ac4c081e7f465668698c311aa9af">
<code>toRecipients</code> – List of primary recipients as a JSON string array. Provide as a JSON string (Python-style with single quotes is supported).<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ee50f2d9678bd463f9934400d058a9642">
<strong>Single recipient</strong> – <code>[{'emailAddress': {'address': 'user@company.com'}}]</code>. </li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee81fe6398808e962e72f53654daad128">
<strong>With name</strong> – <code>[{'emailAddress': {'name': 'John Doe', 'address': 'john@company.com'}}]</code>. </li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef688fe0727a6522f45b99e16072983fc">(Optional) <code>bccRecipients</code> – List of BCC recipients as a JSON string array. Same format as <code>toRecipients</code>. Provide as a JSON string (Python-style with single quotes is supported).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edf49ebffc51a3ed6a1ab5a30b142db9d">(Optional) <code>body</code> – Alias for <code>bodyContent</code>. The email body content, plain text or HTML. Use <code>bodyContent</code> instead when possible.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e49c43780c7633b98b402f316bfc41ab4">(Optional) <code>bodyContent</code> – The email body content, plain text or HTML markup. <ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef29b14636209618d871aa891e10b6b04">
<strong>For plain text</strong> – "Hi team, here is the update." </li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec63eb5e6ff61b5cce0c4e5b0fb23251d">
<strong>For HTML</strong> – "<h1>Title</h1><p>Body paragraph</p>".</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e11f484d448651f15b6fee488315ba3e1">(Optional) <code>bodyContentType</code> – Content type of the email body. Values: <code>Text</code> or <code>HTML</code>. Default: <code>Text</code>. Set to <code>HTML</code> when <code>bodyContent</code> contains HTML markup.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e95507a6222e63469db597b0e2d0954c4">(Optional) <code>ccRecipients</code> – List of CC recipients as a JSON string array. Same format as <code>toRecipients</code>. Provide as a JSON string (Python-style with single quotes is supported).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e938d9abe590f349df8e39ddb4e620f7d">(Optional) <code>importance</code> – Importance level of the email. Values: <code>low</code>, <code>normal</code>, and <code>high</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e24f049302f59faec516caec774c816bc">(Optional) <code>saveToSentItems</code> – Whether to save the sent email in the Sent Items folder (default: true).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e94022accb89fa356fc3ade418becdc18">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5791cab45e22a8e5f8cf18d9f2aaba85"><em>Send an email to John with the subject "Project Update" and body "Here is the latest".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e78eb3f9d9499db5d5d7c9d10f8c8543b"><em>Email the marketing team about the Q4 results.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5dbcb1a581a325d9c2e02195fceca60a"><em>Send a high importance email to my manager with the weekly report.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_people_search</code> – Search for people relevant to you.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e6bbb84780d0d033c68d0b8c149c97e8f">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ee2f06f0faa2413bde4000da74243428b">Find a person by name to send them a Teams chat message.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e470c010e92ae8158ea460f44a1709242">Find contact information for a colleague by name.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e37064178b1cf381b23b31c552da8edf4">Look up a person's email, phone, title, or department.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eab4c41c0731160c5b3e322b083d4e79c">Discover people the user frequently collaborates with.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e88ea97758004231dc7c6582324cd4733">Search for people by name or email address.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed8b26057b74591ebef01ba0660c628f6">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e5db2348c97f6f350524d5e1e1ddde775">(Optional) <code>filter</code> – OData filter expression (for example, <code>personType/class eq 'Person'</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4925154d38fe7b3a8a29b3abdc2a4f07">(Optional) <code>search</code> – Search query for fuzzy name or email matching. Example: <code>John Smith</code> or <code>john@company.com</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecd19ddeb98fed6753c529018073ebb71">(Optional) <code>select</code> – Comma-separated list of fields to return (for example, <code>displayName,scoredEmailAddresses,jobTitle</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee0a8115ccd215d809c194af745c02bea">(Optional) <code>top</code> – Maximum number of people to return (default: 10).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea1da586534c1be8e765a4fd592d3338f">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec0010aa6f1fbd9ff31ecd400d2da4cf8"><em>Find John Smith in the company directory.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e46b8f364682a57fc391e1ceb003ddb93"><em>What is Sarah's email address?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e771a664252a4568c5be2896a4b5a1da8"><em>Search for people in the marketing department.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_settings_get_mail_tips</code> – Get mail tips for one or more recipients to check their availability, Out of office (OOO) status, and mailbox restrictions.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e7c8bf9e1f832e9375c45b99982430bb9">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eebd4fbac52141ba0b339d8e120617a3b">Check if someone is out of office before emailing them.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e25f3a3b9cd09a0fb70aa30b2de3cd620">Verify recipient mailbox status (full or restricted).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e081c100187f48ef3fdea5b1421743549">Check auto-reply messages for multiple people at once.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9b38b6bfcccbfe2579b87ea73caa860e">Determine if a distribution list is moderated.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e97927b762424d672158132434ae45367">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e7d3324cf649deaf515317b45dabc67dd">
<code>emailAddresses</code> – Email addresses to check as a JSON string array. Provide as a JSON string (Python-style supported).<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e63efbbe51b0341f7215c82d9bacf9f9f">
<strong>Single</strong> – `"['john@company.com']. </li>
<li data-list-item-id="e606092a6418c9120bb1ff57420eb2d1c">
<strong>Multiple</strong> – <code>['alice@co.com', 'bob@co.com']</code>. </li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee461da8312e0903f3894457100c31ab0">(Optional) <code>mailTipsOptions</code> – Types of mail tips to retrieve as a JSON string array. Example: <code>['automaticReplies', 'mailboxFullStatus']</code>. If not specified, defaults to <code>automaticReplies</code>. Provide as a JSON string (Python-style supported).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e54d1df9c1aa2ece5400b52dbade74953">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e497a88ae600a89e383ef44a55da56afc"><em>Check if John is out of office before I email him.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="edfaea79916d31e07cf82ecfeeaf127fe"><em>Can you get the mail tips for the marketing team distribution list?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e2fb788cdf3c9923a30b0d0a1b17a4a00"><em>Check if Alice's mailbox is full.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_settings_get_mailbox</code> – Get your mailbox settings.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e886c6cf84f3010cf17fb1c7e13cfbf0a">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eccf2e0226794c3eb527ded833dd56d47">Check if you have out-of-office or automatic replies enabled.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef765f2dbcd7333b092dec748de47c406">View your working hours and timezone.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8d94be040cabf9adff6af8eee5cfc505">Get your language and date format preferences.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e582dbbbbee0dc12b9c9f27b84354ae98">Check the current OOO message content.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e01abdd16c3e06d2cb2c1ede815053d70">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul><li data-list-item-id="e144ef8aaf72db17a61a0bf7c87e65302">(Optional) <code>select</code> – Comma-separated list of settings to return. Options: <code>automaticRepliesSetting</code>, <code>timeZone</code>, <code>language</code>, <code>workingHours</code>, <code>dateFormat</code>, and <code>timeFormat</code>.</li></ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eef23026d5d323cb78d232ec76b2b274c">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ecbaa731d984c154e32e667ce41e076c7"><em>What are my current mailbox settings?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e4cc9648cc339ba68f55decad2af69c80"><em>Check if my out-of-office is currently turned on.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ef805f2259fbda747606b781002aed67c"><em>What timezone is my mailbox set to?</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>outlook_settings_set_automatic_replies</code> – Configure your automatic replies (out of office).</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e1638396cf89fbcfa3540f949bc3d89fc">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ec6362db0ee1b5db0a0304ec2e53c97e7">Turn on or off out-of-office automatic replies.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea0a5fc2193d3d4c203f9cb64ef05cf87">Set the internal and external reply messages.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e76930834611a5ef69bded0955bed3934">Schedule automatic replies for a specific date range.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea92bc0ff621ae0577bfa7cfa3b790c66">Configure who receives external replies.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ee6766014bb829ca0578dd654b32b623d">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ec5bb97dfada3123dd6ee31f47e19fa72">
<code>status</code> – Automatic replies status. Values: <code>disabled</code>, <code>alwaysEnabled</code>, and <code>scheduled</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0eb8a081fbb6e1cfaff052019532b965">(Optional) <code>externalAudience</code> – Who receives the external reply. Values: <code>none</code>, <code>contactsOnly</code>, or <code>all</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e55730be0f06ba1b1d9cc31cf0fb67f6d">(Optional) <code>externalReplyMessage</code> – Reply message for people outside your organization. Supports HTML formatting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8aabd47488a1461da69dcf4d92f9ea98">(Optional) <code>internalReplyMessage</code> – Reply message for people inside your organization. Supports HTML formatting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec4df4e2084be19be451780a64ff4c3ce">(Optional) <code>scheduledEndDateTime</code> – End time for scheduled replies as JSON string. Format: <code>{'dateTime': '2025-04-21T00:00:00', 'timeZone': 'America/New_York'}</code>. Required when <code>status</code> is <code>scheduled</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e44919466ae8a47217dc0f7b097e2370e">(Optional) <code>scheduledStartDateTime</code> – Start time for scheduled replies as JSON string. Format: <code>{'dateTime': '2025-04-14T00:00:00', 'timeZone': 'America/New_York'}</code>. Required when <code>status</code> is <code>scheduled</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e8e79e91f45e83f7cb8e884a51dcecbbd">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e148c81b7fd7bd42c8abbe2b7e3a45e91"><em>Turn on my out of office replies with the message "I am on vacation".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ef109f1f33b20438170d04061f8d6e5bb"><em>Schedule my automatic replies for next week from Monday to Friday.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ecdf1851eab66cdcc0d61fbea9582f111"><em>Turn off my out of office automatic replies.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h3 id="h_01KT73DMBXT8B76T0DDSAGB66C">Microsoft Teams tools<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KT73DMBXT8B76T0DDSAGB66C"></a></h3><details><summary><code>teams_chat_create_chat</code> – Create a new Microsoft Teams chat (1:1 or group).</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea6d8baf947424250c2fcb870b93c6371">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e7a90935bb9e7f9f1bf6cf8e00517176e">Start a new 1:1 chat with someone (or get the existing one).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7de75e74e997de80145aac8776ede9bf">Create a group chat with multiple people.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e049cdd2bf79c3ee96d2e9138c02bc909">Get the <code>chatId</code> needed to send a message to a person.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef284b45ca26d1a977e7a6b6a9bf23d0e">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e8ed89e90c2ca4ab4f2a1872d9a88394e">
<code>memberUserIds</code> – Comma-separated list of user IDs (Azure AD object IDs or email addresses) for the chat members. For 1:1 chats, provide exactly 2 IDs (the authenticated user and the other person). For group chats, provide at least 2 IDs. Example: <code>8b081ef6-4792-4def-b2c9-c363a1bf41d5, 82af01c5-f7cc-4a2e-a728-3a5df21afd9d</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4f41c3a666ca41178ba491ddcbfb49f3">(Optional) <code>chatType</code> – Type of chat to create. Values: <code>oneOnOne</code> or <code>group</code>. Defaults to <code>oneOnOne</code> if not specified.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e74501d51149ea77550475f5584fea077">(Optional) <code>topic</code> – Title or topic for the chat. Only supported for group chats. Ignored for 1:1 chats. Example: <code>Project Planning</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e4d3b2ae0f4d0a0401b8068a360a474ea">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e0b6ad4454f4fdea7b0570b11b444d442"><em>Start a new chat with john.doe@company.com.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="edb67e01f152aa458ad27225b35cf3b98"><em>Create a group chat with Alice, Bob, and Charlie.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e0b2959dc3bd357498fd0d469f977f989"><em>Set up a new Teams chat titled "Project Planning" with the marketing leads.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>teams_chat_list_chats</code> – List your 1:1 and group chats in Microsoft Teams.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e6b21def1054a2c4bb41d60d88e632d46">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e5ba6ea36e4c90510f4078f66dda01a82">List your recent chats.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3124ce0988c0f5bc64e1f6cd21e91513">Filter chats by chat type (<code>oneOnOne</code>, <code>group</code>, or <code>meeting</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef4b287223f24265a3852e7bd4653909c">Expand chat details to include members or last message preview.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eefa7b8e43cef7238861235cd9ef0ffbb">Paginate through your chat list.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eecf083b02a50984a2a19ba223b85385a">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e82dec3a45f98a5826ac76eaf26ddc80d">(Optional) <code>expand</code> – Comma-separated list of related entities to expand. Supported values: <code>members</code> and <code>lastMessagePreview</code>. Example: <code>members,lastMessagePreview</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea7cd4ca3405d28d4e1f5be1eb7b70b3c">(Optional) <code>filter</code> – OData filter expression for filtering chats. Example: <code>chatType eq 'oneOnOne'</code> or <code>chatType eq 'group'</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e11b98f2b0f9b6825ba4638ffcd566e06">(Optional) <code>orderBy</code> – Field to order results by. Example: <code>lastUpdatedDateTime desc</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e13869dc639630a3b9672de339962d2ac">(Optional) <code>skip</code> – Number of chats to skip for pagination.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea13f4b69727febcd8041d19ea90455e3">(Optional) <code>top</code> – Maximum number of chats to return (max 50).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e234e81abd63e59eafa571178851439ae">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e00e2ac8c2ed832061d9d5e9b35e92f8d"><em>Show me my recent Teams chats.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e163f4159a26bcca98790a23faadaaaa4"><em>List my group chats in Teams.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e6758d6db065c5b295dab5e72705c3e1b"><em>Get the last 10 1:1 chats I had.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>teams_chat_list_messages</code> – List messages in a specific Microsoft Teams chat (1:1, group, or meeting chat).</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e4b9d00e9b4abeb2175870bdb364ad86e">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eabffee8fe078f355ccba69a5ccd891a5">Read recent messages in a 1:1 direct message conversation.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eebc2201d967f6f70ceadfbd0a80cd79d">View chat history for a group chat.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e425c509e0da9a389021cda48d83c7726">Get the latest messages from a meeting chat.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eee1d3d7755980235ed5899b6391fefe6">Get messages with sender information.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e447d1d606c0ea8e8c8d32e7e5cbef90d">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ed70ef6356935c8404af3a13032649125">
<code>chatId</code> – The unique identifier of the chat to retrieve messages from. Example: <code>19:abc123@thread.v2</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eefaef39356b56f4ab388ffe28ba0b485">(Optional) <code>top</code> – Maximum number of messages to return (default 20, max 50).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e447171ca11700153a467ad01725b99c1">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e4412170d03b1af74b75ef08bdcff048f"><em>Show me the recent messages from my chat with John.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e2bfed786e5da6c55bc8560530b342efd"><em>Read the last 10 messages from the Q3 Planning group chat.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb1a93b57dc6e77d448ef25dc8ba9f3de"><em>What did we discuss in the recent meeting chat?</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>teams_chat_search_chats</code> – Search Microsoft Teams chats by keyword.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e240e5734cdb87c87fe4f1aa348377a52">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef66e50cbafaff101a3465770b7070051">Find chats about a specific topic or project.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea0100747a22dbb9fb8a3b19434dd2b65">Find a specific group or meeting chat with a person.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3b9a49657e08826d9fe7d46200936185">Locate chats containing specific keywords in recent messages.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec5d8add3502bb7a723144b499fb05ed9">Filter search results by chat type (<code>oneOnOne</code>, <code>group</code>, or <code>meeting</code>).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e5cc2a94a720739594ecdf739de26f282">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e33ddb7cb9c432efd8ca45e508c350ca6">
<code>query</code> – Search keyword to match against chat topics, participant names, and last message content. Example: <code>project update</code> or <code>John Smith</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e027bfc395142a641712e5e0c76f75c08">(Optional) <code>chatType</code> – Filter results by chat type. Values: <code>oneOnOne</code>, <code>group</code>, or <code>meeting</code>. If not specified, all chat types are searched.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e18878faa80272f12e636bfda29ea4f00">(Optional) <code>top</code> – Maximum number of matching chats to return (default 10, max 200).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e614fb1ed7de6e7f4ba76c0a780c5ea25">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ef94f047d2df1b3def12cca6028f844ad"><em>Search my Teams chats for "budget review".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5ffe02e5e66ab6864a66a26b91a489c2"><em>Find the group chat I have with Sarah about the Q2 launch.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e0a179389668aa07af0276ad09688a0ae"><em>Look for any recent chats mentioning the new design.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>teams_chat_send_message</code> – Send a message in a Microsoft Teams chat.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="efe2159d3753a0defe2ca50891ef0ea11">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ec33cb5c19c10eefaf293dc8bec5dba06">Send a text or HTML message in a Teams chat.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea9e016df69b16967bbe6dd376417ceed">Send messages with different importance levels.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecb997cf2f6269bae45923284ee749db5">Communicate with individuals or groups via chat.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e0991a49ad6137eb636a48382ae4b4e11">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e44d2c7e4ad0d8f5557d9b5a81fb16336">
<code>body</code> – The message content to send. Pass the message text directly as a string. For formatted messages, use HTML tags like <code><b></code>, <code><em></code>, <code><br></code>, <code><ul>/<li></code>. Markdown formatting (<code>**bold**</code>, <code>*italic*</code>, <code>-</code> lists) is also supported and are automatically converted to HTML. Examples: <code>Hello, how are you?</code>, <code><p>Here is the <b>update</b>.</p></code>, <code>**Important**: Please review the document.</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e494f40afb839c448116c84a491f797f0">
<code>chatId</code> – The unique identifier of the chat to send the message to. Example: <code>19:abc123@thread.v2</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef238fe1c89f7a1ac5fea0cc5111fccea">(Optional) <code>importance</code> – Importance level of the message. Values: <code>normal</code>, <code>high</code>, or <code>urgent</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e5d327ab0a36af4559c7d5a58f6f9db03">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eabeda9d0a35dabf4977ecdd1fa79d536"><em>Send a message to John saying "Hello, how are you?".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e4190628b667e27e0ca044f0215cf058e"><em>Post a high importance message in the Q3 Planning chat.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5736faf24fc9c023609ee8c5d03faa20"><em>Send a quick update to the marketing group chat.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>teams_chat_summarize</code> – Retrieve and format a Microsoft Teams chat conversation for summarization.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eaee2c27d2122d16140f066c2b2bd8bd3">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e5d754747b3a41e479e36d7f2a0bdb7c4">Get a summary of a chat conversation.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb8dbc13590fc955e406e04472f2923fe">Review what was discussed in a specific chat.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9253974d6de26608ccadb6c352327235">Catch up on a chat you missed.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e38bbafc6803297bf6e2c9dd60290243e">Get an overview of chat participants and activity.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e03165334ba4185288a1888dba3bae3f6">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e15f6d7455ee4221f6c5a1e87216b4c07">
<code>chatId</code> – The unique identifier of the chat to summarize. Use <code>teams_chat_list_chats</code> or <code>teams_chat_search_chats</code> to find the chat ID. Example: <code>19:abc123@thread.v2</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4d8eedecd0d7c562ffd70cbae86daf01">(Optional) <code>messageCount</code> – Number of recent messages to include in the summary (default 50, max 500). Use a lower number for a quick overview.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e60b546f5118233cf7bd4dd37e0a6cd46">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e4b201a4034f090a493e824e3688d8159"><em>Summarize my recent chat with Sarah.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e4f4be1c41835a9589d4da8ffc18eef30"><em>What was decided in the Project Alpha group chat?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e409de53141cb4e21bf1d76e44ba41b32"><em>Give me a recap of the last 20 messages in the design sync chat.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>teams_list_channel_messages</code> – List messages in a Microsoft Teams channel (not a 1:1 or group chat).</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e6d967fd01a876569a003766bf3073286">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e4fb47d064e8a5b3430828866f90d6701">When you want to find information in a channel.</li>

</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ec2edeaaf9158bc294eb8387d4fef3366">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ee557e77eea1ea30583f984e56db0dd98">
<code>channelId</code> – The ID of the channel to list messages from. Use <code>teams_list_channels</code> to find the channel ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e71320e6ae9841af56d46b88066ce714c">
<code>teamId</code> – The ID of the team containing the channel. Use <code>teams_list_joined_teams</code> to find the team ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1838756b6d5123850bb6a468440678d4">(Optional) <code>top</code> – Maximum number of messages to return (default: 20, max: 50).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e4c0683d797d0cb288ae9dd50be4db842">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb9d71d1b801b838e02a65fd2c8a256ae"><em>Show me the latest messages in the General channel of the Marketing team.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec5ac54b118d4fa595bb92ea463eaf910"><em>What was posted recently in the Engineering team's announcements channel?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec90c0dfdc41ff509d740b84b2ed88782"><em>Fetch the last 10 messages from the Design channel.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>teams_list_channels</code> – List channels in a Microsoft Teams team.</summary><div><ul>

<li data-list-item-id="ea8f4b85f498483f9421fac4a976906fc">Discover available channels to post messages in.</li>

</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e21a8a03a068b0d165aecea8e6229c457">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e407a605e759ff31be7b43fb8e5b748d0">
<code>teamId</code> – The ID of the team to list channels from. Use <code>teams_list_joined_teams</code> to find the team ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4c36576c242a500186173ecc5ab40725">(Optional) <code>filter</code> – OData filter expression. Example: <code>startswith(displayName,'General')</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e383be22e4b2ae9fa455aa10da722c539">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e54785156acdf3622b28ffa1bccd3f989"><em>What channels are in the Sales team?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e3e2a62824033879e9a584f505311085d"><em>List all the channels for the Engineering group.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed2fe1ecc611df5f8c529aa260bbfbbe4"><em>Find the Announcements channel in the HR team.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>teams_list_joined_teams</code> – List Microsoft Teams you have joined.</summary><div><ul>

</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea6bb8d6280327d9b2e86a43c47683842">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e9ab2b6680d9f14145b2608d83c02b144">(Optional) <code>filter</code> – OData filter expression. Example: <code>startswith(displayName,'Marketing')</code>.</li>

<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>

<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ef53866d776790025e0eeedaa9d3e74ce"><em>Which Teams am I a member of?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e342ffe60cab8c855923bc329d77af7af"><em>Find the Marketing team in my Teams list.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>teams_list_tags</code> – List all tags defined in a Microsoft Teams team.</summary><div><ul>

<li data-list-item-id="e546b446976a2609a47f2a5810dcc4eb0">Find tag names for mentioning groups of people.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e639964da365d1b7f761c00f41bd0e3a8">Check how many members belong to each tag.</li>

</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e902c7a696cbd821356345219bb68068a">

<code>teamId</code> – The ID of the team to list tags for. Use <code>teams_list_joined_teams</code> to find the team ID.</li></ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea1ad29307a2bf97e833d31a6e2c9554c">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e4724db7b3a122c548b9e15f7dd404798"><em>List all tags in the Marketing team.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e291bf60167c8c0ebcfb75657f3f8934e"><em>What tags are available in this team?</em></li>

</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>teams_list_team_members</code> – List members of a Microsoft Teams team.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e20859d89dcbfbe0f0d91a3555aab38a0">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb38911541e443961e63057d0284a46d7">View all members of a specific team or channel.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e96af9660c07d6052aa74ea24a93ff1d0">Check member roles (<code>owner</code>, <code>member</code>, or <code>guest</code>) within a team.</li>

</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e1f3be1db56f79f8b00d8df6f32460414">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="edf405a0b87d503f7fdb6aea007ae4543">
<code>teamId</code> – The ID of the team to list members from. Use <code>teams_list_joined_teams</code> to find the team ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8ae6e97d0e1cbde35b0480e3c01d75e8">(Optional) <code>filter</code> – OData filter expression on <code>displayName</code> only. Example: <code>startsWith(displayName,'John')</code>. Only <code>displayName</code> is supported, do not use mail or email.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e502872a21f3d8a5296cd6098cae49db3">(Optional) <code>nextLink</code> – Pagination URL from a previous response.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecc33ba361169aa19685f692602bb42bb">(Optional) <code>top</code> – Maximum number of members to return.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e53f7240497c570b127239d2289a8d659">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb1ec129308946d45eee0882dd7d0c356"><em>List all members of the Marketing team.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e1ae7facfb5b90af29ece0fb0e68057a5"><em>Who is in the Engineering team?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed68726958c99818a948c2eb141806ae0"><em>Find members named John in the Sales team.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>teams_presence_get_batch</code> – Get the presence or availability status for multiple users at once in Microsoft Teams.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e9a4523475b78e25004dac097428071fe">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e1ccc07af7b085ea0e7bb04465aacb793">Check availability of multiple team members at once.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9e6dad662289df8669437de5d931a2c6">Get presence status for an entire team or group.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eac55d9ea13a2ebc2657fc51951d782b3">Monitor availability of key contacts.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3d64c63eee2fea682617603fc9c431fe">Find who is available for a meeting.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef71d15f1126169769895267c1fd758b2">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul><li data-list-item-id="ee1f71bcfee48327a1da4eab0ef5cce07">
<code>ids</code> – JSON string array of user IDs (GUIDs) to get presence for. Format: <code>['id1', 'id2', 'id3']</code>. Provide as a JSON string (Python-style with single quotes is supported).</li></ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e3835595744e03cd151a163cf4d8b588e">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e8ace7f0ebbb35990ee8b0e95385a109d"><em>Check the status of these team members.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ecc9adfe089716dfbf604cb27447be8cb"><em>Are John and Sarah available right now?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5b417db89ae4a3ba6ebc67d11e5f26ce"><em>Get the presence for the whole group.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>teams_presence_get_user</code> – Get the presence or availability status for a specific user in Microsoft Teams.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ebc663d30fe5e588f83773d7d10a31d8f">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eee2d373889e638d77fac98b8c51bb99a">Check if a user is available before messaging them.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4f18b967ca70af8392ac8f1377537dcf">See a colleague's current status (busy, away, and so on).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea01059a30f1e4c781f714af5f54362f9">Check if someone is in a meeting or out of office.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3acc4cda18f94ee62c2a1cf85b0cd276">View out-of-office settings and messages.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e9353a147c0316c0e5591786267f87278">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul><li data-list-item-id="e60eccd69782d83680a52b3ad22638bb8">
<code>userId</code> – The user ID (GUID) or user principal name (email address) of the user whose presence to retrieve.</li></ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea55cb4c3e37b3c48a93ee19ffa29033a">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed9a5225ddfde7e5ae99cff115d732da3"><em>Is John available right now?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="efeb456ed799b2dc212f34f2db489232f"><em>Check if Sarah is currently in a meeting.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e6e0dcb70d405c6df4d37ed2680c2a9e1"><em>What is the status of bob@company.com?</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>teams_reply_channel_message</code> – Reply to a message in a Microsoft Teams channel.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e26efe2628299df4b0083333a435f05ae">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e250c783353a37686595049b711977292">Reply to a specific channel message.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed31f54b687b2df7f533e9964eec5b2ad">Continue a threaded conversation in a channel.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e26b9f59716341ce16802e024652a9782">Send text or HTML replies to channel messages.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ede6890a8c4c104d4812d3525b44ba92a">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ed5ba1e811b416d065c5b36dd716a904a">
<code>body</code> – Reply body as a JSON string with <code>contentType</code> and <code>content</code> fields. Format: <code>{'contentType': 'text', 'content': 'Your reply here'}</code> or <code>{'contentType': 'html', 'content': '<p>HTML reply</p>'}</code>. Provide as a JSON string (Python-style with single quotes is supported).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7b62f61a114b8ef72cc9c1203c12b52e">
<code>channelId</code> – The unique identifier of the channel. Example: <code>19:channel123@thread.tacv2</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eca0e98a3eaa2891e9dcfa3fc902e83fa">
<code>messageId</code> – The unique identifier of the message to reply to. Example: <code>1234567890</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efe489337288fe611ca1a05989e032d0a">
<code>teamId</code> – The unique identifier of the team. Example: <code>ab1c2d3e-4f56-7890-abcd-ef0123456789</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e1f4ecb349c5045d62b821e33af6a8e1e">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e8d7505adc6415581c1ccd21e568e70fa"><em>Reply to that channel message with 'Thanks for sharing!'.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb6a1a4792447bfd4fbb37a4a737624a5"><em>Add a reply to the announcement saying I approve.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5288477b61ccd4ed4c63240c4c1e6039"><em>Reply to the latest post in the General channel.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>teams_send_channel_message</code> – Send a message to a Microsoft Teams channel.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e2966295e152e898cc93d1b6afa90e4ec">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e7f2779ceb99665354c7141350577f6fe">Post a message in a Teams channel.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e54f0edf290139c2e5af427e6eaba4f93">Send announcements to a channel.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ede6be9d7ab9b681a1e25a401bdf31f65">Share information with the team through a channel.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1c50aa9170ac0b0ee3cd198f35146029">Send formatted (HTML) messages to a channel.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e52a567e05190ea906278956035fea6bd">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e7a6b233a9f7257b944b0f66179626a3d">
<code>body</code> – The message content to send. Pass the message text directly as a string. For formatted messages, use HTML tags like <code><b></code>, <code><em></code>, <code><br></code>, <code><ul>/<li></code>, and <code><ol>/<li></code>. Markdown formatting (<code>**bold**</code>, <code>*italic*</code>, <code>-</code> lists, and <code>1.</code> numbered lists) is also supported and will be automatically converted to HTML. Examples: <code>Hello team!</code>, <code><p>Here is the <b>update</b>.</p></code>, and <code>**Important**: Please review the document.</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4365f13986a172d74e65ccc901e97dbc">
<code>channelId</code> – The ID of the channel to send the message to. Use <code>teams_list_channels</code> to find the channel ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3d0ef3fab73e866f57d919b21df1a1d6">
<code>teamId</code> – The ID of the team containing the channel. Use <code>teams_list_joined_teams</code> to find the team ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e97a200d99eaa8ef1a8b65842ed75c802">(Optional) <code>importance</code> – Importance level of the message. Values: <code>normal</code>, <code>high</code>, or <code>urgent</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef2e5125f11208089983173642fd3772d">(Optional) <code>subject</code> – Optional subject line for the message.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea911a0c29ef2b665428b5516bc8fc0f6">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed746e8fa31c5cc03e7ff21afc893c14d"><em>Post a message to the General channel saying 'Hello team'.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ee721aec323705c27fd4d75363128ce2d"><em>Send an urgent announcement to the Marketing channel.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb6535745f1139abfea2b1bbe98e2f39f"><em>Post the weekly update to the team channel.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h2 id="h_01KM6K2DP3MV50B5G26V667JK2">Architecture<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KM6K2DP3MV50B5G26V667JK2"></a></h2><h3 id="h_01KM6K2DP3YC68DBEPR4AWGQF9">Authentication and security<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KM6K2DP3YC68DBEPR4AWGQF9"></a></h3><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e9b6a90fe38b633207935747235f5491e">
<strong>Microsoft Azure AD</strong> – Secure authentication through Azure Active Directory.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e47be3c664f11231c92ca59ed2f3bec15">
<strong>MSAL integration</strong> – Microsoft Authentication Library for token management.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7afb9f58bf4e51a37e902637554aaf28">
<strong>OAuth 2.0</strong> – Industry-standard authentication and authorization.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee939c78236f1c096d5527d05854f8326">
<strong>Device code flow</strong> – Secure authentication without password storage.</li>
</ul><h3 id="h_01KM6K2DP46Y0ZYWECZW0EH4Z1">API integration<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KM6K2DP46Y0ZYWECZW0EH4Z1"></a></h3><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e8938ea9ed7c7a5f92e19d8ae98eed929">
<strong>Microsoft Graph API</strong> – Unified endpoint for Microsoft 365 services.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e767595dcfea7ddc6c3a42d02a3becb41">
<strong>REST API</strong> – Standard HTTP-based API communication.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e131ea39483495ae3d637518587e21669">
<strong>Batch operations</strong> – Efficient bulk operations for improved performance.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e749f658a4276970516fc81b603c8edbf">
<strong>Real-time updates</strong> – Support for webhooks and change notifications.</li>
</ul><h2 id="h_01KM6K2DP4TKP30S92XQZZK60Q">Supported Microsoft 365 services<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KM6K2DP4TKP30S92XQZZK60Q"></a></h2><h3 id="h_01KM6K2DPDZCVSYE96VHCBXYP9">Core services<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KM6K2DPDZCVSYE96VHCBXYP9"></a></h3><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e3456ec897bc14234eb2542dae9bd9800">
<strong>Azure Active Directory</strong> – Identity and access management.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed066d38c0366a0dfdd854b2d511ec2ba">
<strong>OneDrive for Business</strong> – Cloud file storage and sync.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef82a7fdb6701e2c3f8d34b33eb814b46">
<strong>SharePoint Online</strong> – Collaboration and document management.</li>
</ul><h3 id="h_01KM6K2DPEPQSKS7WQSR4WKQHR">Data types<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KM6K2DPEPQSKS7WQSR4WKQHR"></a></h3><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb99c59073268dfece894f38b58381c61">
<strong>User profiles</strong> – Personal and organizational information.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e753eb81955c8bc50c7e913411b3b39e9">

BodyMarkdown:
Microsoft 365 connector tools – Support Help Center                   

[Skip to main content](#page-container)

Optimizely Opal's [Microsoft 365 connector tools](#h_01KJGG7HV7X0QXPMSATEX2BPCK) let you manage your Microsoft 365 calendar and file ecosystem directly within the Opal platform. These tools streamline meeting scheduling, calendar management, and file browsing across OneDrive and SharePoint, including capabilities for browsing document libraries, retrieving site pages, and organizing drives. The tools integrate with Microsoft 365, so you do not need to switch between Opal and the Microsoft 365 admin panel or individual apps like Outlook, Teams, or SharePoint.

## Key capabilities[](#h_01KM6K2DNY86GMFD2KR2DEXHY7)

### User and directory management[](#h_01KM6K2DNYAJWS71Q162NENC3Y)

*   **User profiles** – Access and retrieve user information from Azure Active Directory.
*   **Directory operations** – Browse organizational structure and user relationships.
*   **Tenant information** – Get details about the Microsoft 365 organization.

### File and drive operations[](#h_01KM6K2DP0FF5HSD4CZ1B3AQ51)

*   **OneDrive access** – Go to and manage files in OneDrive for Business.
*   **SharePoint integration** – Access SharePoint sites and document libraries.
*   **Drive management** – List and access organizational drives.
*   **File operations** – Read, write, and manipulate files across Microsoft cloud storage.

### Communication and collaboration[](#h_01KM6K2DP11A45XY5JA6JBEGEK)

*   **SharePoint sites** – Access collaborative workspaces and content.
*   **Outlook Calendar** – Schedule and manage meetings and events across your organization.
*   **Outlook email** – Send, read, and organize email messages without leaving Opal.
*   **OneDrive** – Store, share, and collaborate on files and Office documents.

### Security and compliance[](#h_01KM6K2DP1MCPD9C2423F70TK3)

*   **Azure AD authentication** – Secure authentication through Microsoft identity platform.
*   **Token management** – Automatic token refresh and session management.
*   **Permission scoping** – Granular control over API access permissions.
*   **Audit logging** – Comprehensive logging of API operations and access.

## Get started[](#h_01KM6M3XJQKWK4A3APZKPXQX6H)

First, an [Opal administrator](/hc/en-us/articles/36359944449805) must [connect Opal with Microsoft 365](#h_01KM6ME4RQ9ENRXP94SV87SCRW) using Optimizely Connect Platform (OCP). Microsoft 365 uses system-level Open Authorization (OAuth) by default. After installing the connector in OCP and adding the tools to Opal, [users](/hc/en-us/articles/39478258680333) and [agent builders](/hc/en-us/articles/43183109095949) can optionally [log in to Microsoft SharePoint, OneDrive, and Outlook Calendar](#h_01KJZX8RV2QTTTJF3AE1EPH73P) to access their personal Microsoft information from within Opal. Administrators only need to install the Microsoft 365 connection in OCP once.

## Connect Opal with Microsoft 365[](#h_01KM6ME4RQ9ENRXP94SV87SCRW)

As an [Opal administrator](/hc/en-us/articles/36359944449805), complete the following sections to connect Opal with Microsoft 365. Administrators only need to install the Microsoft 365 connection in OCP once.

### Install Microsoft 365 Opal Tools in OCP[](#h_01KJZY0YFREMXZQAMCF4GGN86S)

In the OCP **App Directory**, complete the following:

1.  Click **Microsoft 365 Opal Tools**.
    
    ![Screenshot of the Opal Connectors page where the Microsoft 365 tile is highlighted.](/hc/article_attachments/44780471925645)
    
2.  Click **Install** **App**.
    
    ![Screenshot of the Microsoft 365 Opal Tools app page in OCP where the Install App option is visible.](/hc/article_attachments/44780423897741)
    

### Select tool sets[](#h_01KME7ZQVG055XQ26GJ42B8KTA)

Opal enables all of the Microsoft 365 tools by default. If you do not want all of the Microsoft 365 tools enabled in Opal, complete the following steps:

1.  Go to the **Settings** tab.
2.  Expand **Tool Sets**.
3.  Toggle any of the tool sets on or off.
4.  Click **Save**.
    
    ![Screenshot of the Tool Sets settings panel in OCP where the Save option is highlighted.](/hc/article_attachments/46383219349517)
    

### Add to Opal[](#h_01KN5D3ND7V05D8ZJGF790PFGZ)

1.  Go to the **Settings** tab.
2.  Expand **Add to Opal**.
3.  Click **Add to Opal** to register the Microsoft 365 connector tools to the corresponding Opal instance.
    
    ![Screenshot of the Add to Opal section in OCP with Add to Opal highlighted.](/hc/article_attachments/46383192763533)
    

### Authorize the Opal Microsoft tools in Microsoft Entra[](#h_01KN5ENTRA_AUTHORIZE)

After an Opal administrator connects to the app in OCP, a prompt displays indicating that an administrator needs to authorize the connection. A Microsoft administrator must log in to the Microsoft Entra Admin Center and complete one of the following:

*   **Add the Opal MS Graph Tool app to trusted apps** – Grants the app access for all users in the organization.
*   **Configure access for individual groups** – Restricts the app to specific groups within your organization.

![Screenshot of the Microsoft Entra admin center where the required API permissions for the Opal application are configured.](/hc/article_attachments/45069199683853)

After you complete the previous steps, users and agent builders can follow the steps in the [Authenticate with Microsoft](#h_01KJZX8RV2QTTTJF3AE1EPH73P) section to log in with their personal information if you [enabled instance-level Opal OAuth](#h_01KME7YSWCPGDXSS9HTMBZQFD5).

### Enable self-managed instance-level OAuth (Optional)[](#h_01KME7YSWCPGDXSS9HTMBZQFD5)

The Microsoft 365 tools use Optimizely-managed OAuth by default. This configuration is not required for most organizations and can be skipped. Complete this section only if your organization requires self-managed instance-level OAuth.

If your organization requires self-managed instance-level OAuth, complete the following steps:

1.  Go to the **Settings** tab.
2.  Expand **Microsoft 365 Settings**.
3.  Toggle **Instance level Opal OAuth** on.
4.  Enter your **Microsoft 365 auth provider ID**, which is the name of the Microsoft 365 auth provider connection configured in Opal. 
5.  Click **Save**. 
    
    ![](/hc/article_attachments/46383219351053)
